merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Libellus Sanguinis 4 - Thieves in the Night
merits.descricao: You possess an aura of holiness, your voice is like that of an angel, and an inner light radiates from you. Others adore you and even those who wish to harm you find it difficult to act. The true source of this blessing is unknown, but those who observe you believe that God has anointed you in some way. Blessed does not confer the benefits of True Faith, but observers may well believe that the character is also touched by God in that manner. Blessed conveys the same benefits as Majesty (no one may insult or attack you while within three meters of you and able to see you. Acting against you requires spending 1 Willpower and making a Social Challenge) among the character's Herd, as long as they do nothing to shatter the divine perception those people hold of them.
merits.name: Blessed

merits.descricao: You are Favored by some power greater than yourself, such that the corrosive touch of hell does not harm you. You are not affected by the paths and rituals of Dark Thaumaturgy. Characters with this Merit can never learn Dark Thaumaturgy. Standard Thaumaturgy functions normally.
merits.name: Blessed

merits.descricao: You have the ability to assist vampires in their attempts to resist the loss of their Humanity. You provide bonus Traits to Conscience tests equal to the level of this Merit when you witness such a scene and offer support to the vampire.
merits.name: Soothe the Beast

merits.descricao: People from all walks of life find it easy to talk to you, and getting even traumatized or suspicious individuals to open up to you requires little effort. You gain a bonus of 2 Traits on all Social Challenges involving ordinary people, and 1 Trait on appropriate tests when dealing with supernatural creatures who still consider themselves at least somewhat human.
merits.name: Approachable

merits.descricao: Toreador with this Merit are more likely to become enraptured (Clan Flaw) when viewing items with a craftsmanship level of 2. However, when using Aura Perception, the player may request additional information from the Storyteller. The information is at the Storyteller's discretion, but may include specific details about the target's Clan, tribe, etc.; whether magic has been used on the target and of what type; and details the target may be obscuring, such as true age, size, etc.
merits.name: Greater Colors

merits.descricao: You strive to keep up with the latest technology and, while this can occasionally strain your finances, it gives you an advantage when trying to figure out the newest devices (with which consumers might be familiar anyway). You are two Traits up on all tests to determine how to operate unfamiliar devices.
merits.name: Early Adopter

merits.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
merits.descricao: You control a major airport, and all members who wish to use it must report to you, as it is your domain.
merits.name: Airport

merits.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
merits.descricao: You have an innate understanding of and affinity with a certain type of animal, such as dogs, bats, rats, cats, or wolves. You gain 2 bonus Traits on Animalism and empathy tests involving those animals.
merits.name: Animal Afinity

merits.descricao: COORD APPROVAL. Provided there are no witnesses and you are not disturbed, you may perform any task requiring craftwork in one third of the normal time. You begin with one additional level of Crafts that can never be lost.
merits.name: Busy Helper

merits.descricao: Over the years, you have managed to befriend — or at least establish cordial relations with — some beings of great power. This might be a Garou sept, an ancient mage, a vampire prince, a Kithain noble, an ancient ghost, a mummy, or something truly bizarre. While none of you would risk life, limb, and soul for one another, you have a habit of helping each other out. This Merit can serve as a springboard for many adventures. The Storyteller has the final say on which allies the character may choose and how much they are worth as a Merit. The Storyteller also defines the statistics for the ally; while the character knows the basics, they should not have an omniscient overview of their friend's capabilities.
merits.name: Powerful Allies

merits.descricao: For each point in this Merit you may choose one species of animal; when feeding from it, the Blood Points drunk are doubled. (You may not choose humans.)
merits.name: Earth-Feeder

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: Your tongue extends to inhuman lengths as a bizarre feeding instrument. It may be delicate and forked like a serpent's or a monstrous cartilaginous spike, but the effect is the same. You may extend your tongue 15 centimeters per point invested in this Merit, and can drain blood or inflict aggravated damage without grappling your prey (as long as it is within range). Unlike traditional feeding, your tongue does not provide the pleasure of the Kiss. Such feeding feels more like a giant mosquito driving a dagger-sized needle into the flesh and siphoning blood quickly enough to ruin the veins.
merits.name: Feeding Tongue

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Libellus Sanguinis 4 - Thieves in the Night
merits.descricao: This Merit grants the Nosferatu a cartilaginous tongue with which it feeds. This characteristic is believed to have originated among larval Nosferatu and their progeny. The tongue cannot extend more than 15cm out of the mouth, but it inflicts aggravated damage wounds (treat the attack as if it were a bite). Unlike the Kiss, this feeding is very painful for the victim. It is like a giant mosquito driving a needle the size of a thorn into the flesh and then sucking blood quickly enough to drain the victim.
merits.name: Feeding Tongue

merits.descricao: In the terrible event that you are diablered, the member who commits the act will gain no benefits (Disciplines, generation) but will suffer all the drawbacks (black veins on the soul, loss of Humanity). Obviously this is not very advantageous for you, but it is an excellent way to give one last "screw you!" to your killer. And the members of your former circle's group can still avenge you. A vampire with this Merit will never become a wraith. Instead, he passes into the unknown beyond after being diablered.
merits.name: Indomitable Soul

merits.descricao: You are able to shake off injuries more easily than most. You have one additional health level of Bruised.
merits.name: High Pain Tolerance

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: Should you commit the heinous sin of Amaranth, your aura will not betray your crime. This Merit cannot conceal the telltale discoloration of a diablerist's aura, nor does it protect against the divinations of blood sorcery. Assamites of the warrior caste may not take this Merit.
merits.name: Hidden Amaranth

merits.descricao: No penalty for actions performed with the off-hand.
merits.name: Ambidestry

merits.descricao: Although you are not a Nosferatu, you know the sewers, tunnels, ducts, subway tubes, and other underground passages of your home city. The local Nosferatu (and any other creatures that dwell in the muck) may not like you, but they are not inclined to kill you on sight within their territory. You suffer -1 difficulty on any test involving the underground world (sneaking from one place to another below ground, finding routes to sub-basements, and so on). Nosferatu may not take this Merit.
merits.name: Friend of the Underground

merits.descricao: You gain 1 additional Temporary Willpower Trait (True Love) per session. Your True Love must be rescued from time to time.
merits.name: True Love

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: Some supernatural force watches over you and protects you from danger. You have no idea who or what holds this concern — in fact, you may not even know that this guardian exists. However, in times of great need, peculiar circumstances defend you from harm. You have no control over this Merit and your protector cannot save you from your own recklessness. The Storyteller should decide why you are being watched over and by what, keeping in mind your path and background. Despite the name, it does not need to be an actual angel — a demonic thaumaturge might well have a demon or other malevolent entity looking out for him, for example.
merits.name: Guardian Angel

merits.descricao: You have seen and done almost everything imaginable. System: Once per session, you may automatically succeed at any non-Combat test that does not involve Disciplines, Blood Sorcery, or other powers. The action may be research or persuasion, Lore, etc. When performing the task, you recall having done something similar before ("When I was at Shiloh...") and draw upon your experience to aid you.
merits.name: Years Of Wisdom

merits.descricao: Mortals Only: Ah, love! You are in love and the world suddenly seems a much better place, allowing you to wake more refreshed than normal each morning. Unlike the Background Soul Mate, this love may be fleeting if you do not work to maintain the relationship (causing you to lose the Merit). However, until that happens, you recover two Willpower Traits from natural rest whenever other hunters would recover one (between games, every good night's sleep, etc.).
merits.name: Lovestruck

merits.fonte: Laws of the Wild: Changing Breeds 1
merits.descricao: This Merit halves the time required to learn a new Power or Ability, although the Experience Trait cost remains the same. HouseRules ICBN: You do not spend downtime to learn things if you possess this Merit.
merits.name: Quick Learner

merits.fonte: Laws of the Hunt: Players Guide
merits.descricao: Choose one non-Combat Ability; you have 2 Bonus Traits on tests involving it. May be taken more than once for a different Ability.
merits.name: Ability Aptitude

merits.descricao: Exactly the opposite of Archaic, you are a visionary who understands that technology will quickly become the way of the world in the coming decades and, by mastering it now, you will be better prepared to face tomorrow's challenges. In fact, you seem to have an almost unnatural ability with mechanical and technological concepts, which places you at a considerable advantage over many of your fellow Members. Whenever you are involved in a challenge to evaluate, operate, or design a mechanical device developed within the last 50 years, you have two additional Traits. This Merit is especially rare among elders.
merits.name: Mechanical Aptitude

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: You are mystically forgettable, shielded from attention and memory by a quirk of circumstance and disinterest. Those who see you rarely remember you afterward. For each point invested in this Merit, subtract one Trait from all tests used to actively seek you out (typically investigation or perception). Being anonymous is not the same as being invisible, however, and Arcane does not help with stealth tests or other attempts to hide. Characters with Influence or Status cannot have Arcane and vice versa, and Arcane can be a drawback for other Backgrounds. Mentors may lose interest in an Arcane protégé, for example.
merits.name: Arcane

merits.descricao: Works the same as Baby Face for the Gangrel's animal form.
merits.name: TBD

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: You are unusually flexible. You gain 1 Bonus Trait on physical challenges involving bodily flexibility (such as escaping bonds or squeezing through tight spaces).
merits.name: Supple Joints

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: You are unusually flexible. You gain 1 Bonus Trait on physical challenges involving bodily flexibility (such as escaping bonds or squeezing through tight spaces). In addition, you can bend most joints backwards, dislocate others at will, and perform contortion feats impossible for a human body (such as turning your head to look directly behind you). You can escape most bonds and slip through small spaces automatically, although the Storyteller may require a challenge for extreme actions.
merits.name: Supple Joints

merits.descricao: You gain 2 Bonus Traits on tests involving driving.
merits.name: Crack Driver

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: A vampire with this Merit may take an action to extend or retract their wings. Retractable wings fold and press tightly against the body, allowing the character to move through narrower spaces and move without impediment. Only gargoyles and other vampires with wings may acquire this Merit.
merits.name: Retractable Wings

merits.descricao: Luck has smiled upon you! When you need it most, especially when you are trying to help another person, fortune seems to fall right into your lap. Spend up to 3 temporary Willpower to gain 3 Luck Re-Tests in the Scene. Note: You cannot have the Ascendant and Midheaven of the same Ruling Planet.
merits.name: Jupiter Rising

merits.descricao: You have a reputation for a volatile temper, perfect for inspiring awe at the destruction you have wrought. You may grant a single bonus Trait or a single additional point of damage on one Physical attack. Note: You cannot have the Ascendant and Midheaven of the same Ruling Planet.
merits.name: Mars Rising

merits.descricao: You have +2 Traits on social tests with Spirits and things of the Umbra. Note: You cannot have the Ascendant and Midheaven of the same Ruling Planet.
merits.name: Mercury Rising

merits.descricao: You have proven yourself worthy of joining the Mile-High Club through your remarkable skill with the sniper rifle. The difficulty of all tests associated with sniping is reduced by -1. You also double the normal range when using a sniper rifle as a weapon.
merits.name: Thousand Meter Killer

merits.descricao: You have the bearing and manners of a true monarch, regardless of how low your station may be. You carry yourself with grace and dignity, and your words resonate with purpose and passion. You gain 2 Bonus Traits on Social Challenges where you can impress others with your nobility. This Merit does not mean you walk around with your chest puffed out and barking orders. Sometimes the greatest nobility shines quietly — stand tall, keep your head high, walk with dignity, raise your voice only when necessary.
merits.name: Noble Bearing

merits.descricao: You gain 1 bonus Trait on all social challenges involving your persona.
merits.name: Noble Bearing

merits.descricao: You have a shining aura of someone with power. Those who sense the aura keep well clear of you, and those who cannot still have a strange feeling about you.
merits.name: Burning Aura

merits.descricao: Your aura is that of a mortal.
merits.name: Brilliant Aura

merits.descricao: Whether you are good at giving orders or simply have a commanding tone, people tend to do what you say. You are not so much a natural leader as a born commander. You gain 2 bonus Traits on Leadership challenges.
merits.name: Aura of Command

merits.descricao: Reading an aura using Auspex requires the observer to focus on recurring patterns and colors to detect a target's emotional state. Due to the unique state of your psyche, your aura is even more difficult to read than most. All uses of Aura Perception have a difficulty of +2 against you.
merits.name: Distracting Aura

merits.descricao: The aura never changes, not even when you are confused, in Frenzy, or in a psychotic episode.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: Giovanni only. You begin play with a partial blood bond to another Giovanni Member (if there is no appropriate player to represent such a character, the Storyteller should work with you to create one). You gain the Basic level of Potence, Vigor, in addition to your other Disciplines, and you may learn the first Intermediate level with your starting Discipline levels. If you spend eight Free Traits on this Merit, you come to play with partial bonds to two Giovanni Members or a full bond to one, and you also gain the Basic level of the Fortitude Discipline, Endurance.
merits.name: Proxy Kiss

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: Your lips have a faint crimson sheen, like roses or fine wine. Whenever you kiss someone, you leave traces of sweet vitae. This secretion is not enough to create a childe or ghoul, though you may administer this blood by kissing on the mouth or touching an open cut with your lips. A Static Mental challenge Difficulty 8 (retest with Alertness) is required to notice the faint taste of blood.
merits.name: Sanctifying Kiss

merits.descricao: Often, attractive people receive more: more gifts, more leeway, and more attention. Good looks can open many doors that would otherwise remain closed. You know how to use your appearance to your advantage and have no scruples about using your good looks to influence others. Whenever you are involved in a challenge with a Discipline that requires you to use your Social Attribute to perform tests, you may benefit from that power's focus benefit even if you do not possess the appropriate Attribute focus. [This is not allowed in OWBN, but I see so many people with it that I decided to include it here]
merits.name: Immortal Beauty

merits.descricao: COORD APPROVAL. You possess a beauty far beyond that of normal mortals, unsettling in its perfection. People are awed by your ideal yet strange form, while an inexplicable subconsciousness nausea rises to the surface. Reduce the difficulty by three on any challenge in which you attempt to attract the attention of a changeling or an individual touched by the fae, or to win them over with your appearance. Other beings find your beauty unnatural, imposing a difficulty of +1 on social challenge attempts.
merits.name: Surreal Beauty

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: You gain +2 Traits on challenges in which you possess no levels in the required Ability. Characters must have Academics x3 to acquire this Merit.
merits.name: Well-Educated

merits.descricao:
- Toad Eyes: Add two Traits to all perception challenges based on vision, and subtract one from the standard Trait penalty for multiple opponents.
- Exoskeleton: The Gangrel gains two Physical Traits for challenges related to strength and one additional level of armor against bashing and lethal damage. However, anyone attempting to stake the Gangrel need only win or tie a single Simple Test after winning the Physical Challenge.
- Hide/Carapace: The vampire gains two levels of armor against bashing and lethal damage, and one against aggravated damage, but suffers a one-Trait penalty on all challenges involving dexterity.
- Mandible: The vampire's bite causes two levels of aggravated damage and can drain three Blood Points per turn while feeding.
- Sonar: The vampire gains a two-Trait bonus on challenges while navigating in darkness, fog, smoke, and similar conditions. People with the Medicine Ability may make a Mental Challenge to notice the changes in voice.
- Spinnerets: Spend one Blood Point to generate one square meter of webbing or 3 meters of a single thick strand. Anyone attempting to break it must win a Static Physical Challenge against a total equal to the Gangrel's Physical Traits (one Trait bonus if the target has claws, a knife, or some other sharp instrument). Observers may make a Mental Challenge to notice the spinnerets, and the vampire suffers a two-Trait penalty to their challenge.
- Tail: Observers may make a Mental Challenge to notice the tail (if hidden), and the vampire suffers a three-Trait penalty to their challenge. The tail inflicts two levels of bashing damage.
- Claws: These function as Claws of the Beast on both hands and feet, except they are not retractable. The vampire suffers a one-Trait penalty on challenges involving fine manipulation.
- Venom: When the vampire successfully bites a target, the target must make a Static Physical Challenge against eight Traits. If the target loses this challenge, they lose one Physical Trait; this damage heals as aggravated damage. A victim who reaches two Physical Traits falls unconscious. Whenever the vampire fails an attack, make two Simple Tests. If the vampire fails both, one or both fangs break and must regenerate as though they had been lost as aggravated damage.
- Wings: These add two bonus Traits on challenges involving balance, and the vampire suffers one level of bashing damage for every 5 meters fallen, instead of 3 meters.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: HR ICBN: You are a true Berserker. You spend an action to let the fury rise and give yourself over to the joy of battle (perhaps cutting yourself with a knife, burning yourself, or biting the handle of your axe, etc). While in Berserker, you enter a state of blind rage in battle, gaining 3 bonus Physical Traits for tiebreaker purposes, you do not receive penalties from Wounds, and you cannot initiate Social or Mental Challenges. It takes 3 turns to calm down and exit this state. You cannot invoke Berserker while wearing Armor or while using a transformative power. You cannot invoke Berserker if you are in Frenzy or Rotschreck.
merits.name: True Berseker

merits.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: Faith and Fire
merits.descricao: You may choose to enter Frenzy even without provocation. All effects of Frenzy still apply (You do not receive Wound penalties. You cannot initiate Social or Mental Challenges, and you do not need to spend Social Traits if challenged.)
merits.name: Berserker

merits.fonte: V20 - The Black Hand, A Guide to the Tal Mahe Ra
merits.descricao: You possess the ability to voluntarily enter a berserker state for one scene. While in berserker, you gain 3 bonus Physical Traits for attack tiebreaker purposes, you do not receive Wound penalties, and you cannot initiate Social or Mental Challenges. You also cannot perform any complex action other than fighting, dodging, or running. IMPORTANT: You are not in Frenzy, but rather in a Berserker fury.
merits.name: Berserker

merits.descricao: You have a library full of occult books. Purely RP.
merits.name: Occult Library

merits.descricao: Perhaps through biological knowledge, or perhaps by unlocking something primordial within yourself, you have accessed the secrets of bioluminescence. Using Vicissitude, you can grant yourself (through the Malleable Aspect) or others (via Fleshcraft) the ability to emit a soft glow. With muscle control and practice, you can control the color and pattern of the illumination. This can light a soft glow in the dark, create beautiful displays, or even act as a primordial form of communication. Some Demons grant bioluminescence to their ghouls or childer, developing an eerily nuanced and wordless language with their servants and broods. Only characters with at least one point of Vicissitude may acquire this Merit.
merits.name: Bioluminescence

merits.descricao:
Blasé does not negate the Toreador Clan Flaw. ICBN HR: You gain Ties in Presence Challenges. 
(Original: Vampires with this merit automatically resist levels 1-4 of the Presence Discipline used against them, including combo powers using levels up to 4. However, if the Presence user is more than two generations older than the target, the target must spend one Willpower Trait to resist.)
merits.name: Blasé

merits.descricao: You have excellent night vision and suffer no penalties from low-light conditions, and your natural self-confidence allows you to halve the normal penalty for operating in total darkness (though this does not apply if you have been physically blinded in some way). In addition, you have 2 bonus Traits on all Mental Challenges involving nocturnal perception.
merits.name: Good Night Vision

merits.descricao: You may take up to 4 Blood Points from your victim per turn.
merits.name: Gaping Maw

merits.descricao: You have a natural talent for choosing the right words to express exactly what you mean, whether communicating your emotions to another person or creating a work of art. You are two Traits above in all Challenges related to Expression or Performance involving primarily words and wordplay.
merits.name: Way With Words

merits.descricao: When making a successful Brawl test to wound a target, you may immediately make a Simple Test — on a win, you inflict one additional level of damage.
merits.name: Good Right/ Left Hook

merits.descricao: Although your knowledge of pop culture may leave something to be desired, you have a special talent for giving the right gifts, quoting the right witticism, and impressing others with how cultured and refined you are. You are two Traits above in any Social Challenge to impress or make contacts with like-minded people, due to the natural acceptance of your excellent taste.
merits.name: Good Taste

merits.descricao: You have an incredible ability to intuit the best course of action in situations involving instinctive responses rather than logic or rational thought. This Merit makes you an ideal companion in the wilderness, where action takes precedence over thinking. You have two additional Traits in Challenges involving Survival.
merits.name: Good Instincts

merits.descricao: You have an innate sense of direction, and when traveling to a familiar location or when you have time to prepare a route to an unfamiliar one, you can reduce travel time between locations by one third, reflecting your talent for following the right path for maximum efficiency.
merits.name: Good Map Reader

merits.descricao: Most people merely wait for their turn to speak, but you genuinely listen to what others are saying, and this willingness to entertain their thoughts without inserting your own opinion means people tend to tell you more than they expect to. In any seemingly friendly situation involving someone speaking more to you than you respond, you are two Traits up in any Social Challenge to obtain information from them, as your receptiveness encourages them to say more than they would about a subject.
merits.name: Good Listener

merits.descricao: Other people may forget a face or a place, but you do not — your ability to remember the names of people you have met only briefly is fantastic, and you can easily recall how to get around places even if you have only been there once before. This is not total recall — that is the Eidetic Memory Merit, above — but simply a gift for remembering names and locations, even if you saw a face for only a fleeting moment on television or heard a name in passing. The difficulty of remembering a name or face you have seen before is reduced by two Traits, as is the difficulty of navigating a location you have previously visited.
merits.name: Good Recognition

merits.descricao: You are Café-com-Leite. Ask the Storytellers for assistance.
merits.name: Common Sense

merits.descricao: Mean mug. You have 1 Bonus Trait on Intimidation tests.
merits.name: Bruiser

merits.descricao: This merit allows the character to resist grueling instruments of torture. They are immune to interrogation through torture unless the aggressor has at least level three in the Torture ability.
merits.name: Broken Rack

merits.descricao: Unlike many Members, you enjoy traveling. You have a solid knowledge of safe travel routes and methodologies, not to mention the refuge spaces available at various destinations. Unless someone knows your exact route and is specifically looking for you, you may move between cities without being hindered by random encounters with Lupines, overly zealous state troopers, and the like.
merits.name: Open Road

merits.descricao: Your face is hideous, but can pass for an ugly human. (Your Appearance remains zero, but it is not a Masquerade breach.)
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: You possess a very powerful ghoul, bound to you by a blood bond. The ghoul has 6 points to distribute among any Disciplines except Thaumaturgy, with at least 1 point required in Potence. Additionally, the ghoul is highly competent, with 15 points to distribute among Attributes, 27 points to distribute among Abilities, and 5 points to apply to Backgrounds. They have reasonably good ratings in Virtues and Willpower and will do anything you ask of them, for they love you deeply. However, they may also become jealous of any relationship you have with others.
merits.name: Powerful Ghoul

merits.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
merits.descricao: You are the owner of a castle with at least 50 rooms and perhaps as many as 500. You also control a vast expanse of land surrounding the castle. Servants, should you wish to have them, are provided along with this Merit. The castle may be in as good or as poor a condition as you desire. The more uninhabited it appears to be, the more attention it will draw. Characters from the New World may not take this Merit unless they can justify it — a mad relative moved the castle to the New World stone by stone.
merits.name: Castle

merits.descricao: It is difficult to fool you, as you naturally tend to view all matters as pending until proven and all people with caution until they have earned your trust. However, this is not paranoia — generally you simply require some form of evidence before buying into something, even if it sometimes burns you because of it. On the other hand, you have two additional Traits on all tests to detect a lie.
merits.name: Healthy Skepticism

merits.descricao: You own a moderately sized nightclub, perhaps one of the most popular night spots in the city. It brings you enough money to support a decent lifestyle (a stipend of $1,000 per month, which can be increased by taking Influences), and also provides an excellent location for a prime haven (though this requires the necessary Background) or even just a general meeting place. The name of the club, its style, its design, and a description of its regular clientele are up to you (within reason). Variations of this Merit may include a restaurant, theater, comedy club, sports arena, or retail store, with the Storyteller's permission, of course.
merits.name: Nightclub

merits.descricao: You gain 3 bonus Traits on tests involving logic and mathematics.
merits.name: Natural Cipher

merits.descricao: Gain a Social or Mental retest when the situation might violate your code of honor.
merits.name: Code of Honor

merits.descricao: When you fail Conscience tests, but not Conviction, you may gain a new test for free by spending a Willpower. The violation is treated as one level higher on the Hierarchy of Sins, however, and you must accept the results. You must have and maintain a Morality of at least three to acquire and use this Merit.
merits.name: Compassionate

merits.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
merits.descricao: This Merit is identical to Spiritual Mentor, and you can see and touch him in the Underworld, however your relationship is more... romantic...
merits.name: Wraith Companion

merits.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
merits.descricao: You have a friend and ally who is a mage. Although you can call on him in times of need, he may also want to call on you. This mage is probably an Euthanatos or Verbena, but can be from any tradition or convention.
merits.name: Mage Companion

merits.descricao: Reptile Companion (Physical 7, Social 0, Mental 2, Fortitude 2, Potence 2, Blood Points 12, Willpower 3)
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: Suffers no penalties from distractions or external phenomena.
merits.name: Concentration

merits.descricao: Business is war, or so they say, and if that's true, then you already have a few missions on your resume. You understand corporate dynamics very well, from how to motivate people to how resources flow within a company to the best way to climb the hierarchy, and you have no trouble managing business affairs efficiently and profitably when you put your mind to it. Whenever you attempt to manipulate a corporation or a corporate employee in a matter related to business, you are two Traits up on related tests. You must have at least six Social Traits and one level of Finance Ability to acquire this Merit.
merits.name: Corporate Sawy

merits.descricao: A born spin doctor, you instinctively understand exactly the right things to say to journalists to present your subject the way you want, allowing you to create, suppress, or redirect stories with relative ease. With sufficient time to prepare or with a friendly contact in the press, you can even set up situations for the press to read them the way you desire. You are two Traits up on all Social Challenges made with journalists or news organizations of any kind.
merits.name: Mídia Sawy

merits.descricao: Hedge Magic is CoordApproval. You studied the secrets of runes during your mortal life. As a result you have the ability to perform magic by carving runes and enchanting them with sacrifices of your own blood and power. You may purchase Hedge Magic from World of Darkness: Sorcerer, either at character creation (with bonus points only) or during play, at the experience cost listed in Sorcerer. You may learn any magical Path up to your level of Rune Lore (a Secondary Ability presented in the book). You must spend time to activate these sorceries, as a normal sorcerer would, but instead of spending Willpower, you must use Blood Points to complete your spells. You carve runes in a delicate ritual to call forth your magic. A rune-maker cannot simply "cast a spell," but must carefully draw his runes. You know only Scandinavian magic, and may not purchase the Alchemy, Conjuration, Conveyance, Hellfire or Summoning, Binding and Warding (Material) paths, nor Thaumaturgy, whether paths or rituals, without learning the Discipline in the usual way. Face it, you are (probably) not a Tremere. Note that your magic is not the same as Mortal Sorcery; instead, you awaken the power of the runes with the potency of supernatural blood itself. Because you must discover the secrets of this strange power on your own, you cannot learn other types of Mortal Sorcery, and they cannot learn to use yours. The high cost of this Merit reflects the rarity of Norse Rune Sorcerers.
merits.name: Rune-Wise

merits.descricao: A good number of people have at least a rudimentary knowledge of computers and their ability to locate information online, but you go beyond that common knowledge with your natural abilities — you navigate online resources instinctively and need spend only the minimum amount of time to find what you are looking for when hunting for data. Requires six Mental Traits or two levels of Computer Ability to acquire this Merit.
merits.name: Internet Sawy

merits.descricao: You have expertise in a specific field that makes your conversation intriguing to an older Member. As long as your knowledge holds the other vampire's attention, he will have an interest in keeping you around. Then again, once he has wrung you dry of every last bit of information you possess, that patronage may vanish suddenly. (Note: This Merit should be played as a 1-point Mentor with a specific interest. However, unlike a Mentor, Useful Knowledge does not imply a permanent relationship.)
merits.name: Useful Knowledge

merits.descricao: The character tastes another person's blood (potentially risking the blood bond), and the player makes a Static Mental Challenge (Retest with Empathy) difficulty 6 for mortals or 8 for Kindred. If the blood came from a mortal, the character is able to discover their Nature, Demeanor, and any Derangements they may possess, whether they are blood bound, and whether they carry any blood-borne disease. If the vitae came from a vampire, they may learn all of the above information, in addition to anything that can be discovered at the first level of Blood Trail. Vampires who do not possess Auspex x2 may not acquire this Merit.
merits.name: Connoisseur

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Libellus Sanguinis 2 - Keepers of the Word
merits.descricao: You have two bonus Traits against Presence Challenges.
merits.name: Bearing of Kings

merits.descricao: Restless Dead and Spirits receive 2 bonus Traits to possess/inhabit you - however, you retain full awareness while possessed, regardless of the level of the Arcanos Inhabit.
merits.name: Easy Consort

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Libellus Sanguinis 2 - Keepers of the Word
merits.descricao: You are in a relationship very similar to a marriage with another vampire. The married pair share the benefits of the True Love Merit with one another. This Merit in conjunction with 'Closer than Blood' allows a remarkable degree of intimacy - you may even be able to occasionally share Disciplines. Your consort is likely equal to you in power and status, but together you present a formidable front. You would kill and die for one another, and God help the fool who comes between you or harms your beloved.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: Your natural abilities with illusions have made you particularly weary and unimpressed. How can anything be as perfect as your own imagination? Because of this, your heart is harder than most and you have a significant resistance to emotional manipulation. All powers and social challenges that attempt to manipulate you emotionally are made at difficulty +2.
merits.name: Heart of Needles

merits.descricao: You gain 1 extra Vitality Level in Healthy.
merits.name: Warrior's Heart

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: It is suggested that this Merit be acquired only by characters on the path of the Road of Kings (or Via Adversarius). This Merit allows the character to spend one temporary Willpower so that their current levels of Self-Control and Courage are adjusted to their current Morality level. This lasts for the scene and this benefit may only be used once per story. It is suggested that a story be considered by Storytellers as approximately one and a half months, or 3 game sessions - whichever is greater.
merits.name: Lion-Hearted

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: Your heart is protected by a sheath of leather-like cartilage or curved bone. For each point invested in this Merit, you gain 1 additional Trait against attempts to stake or other attacks that aim to pierce the heart.
merits.name: Heart of Bone

merits.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: The Long Night
merits.descricao: Your heart is out of its conventional location, up to two hand-spans from the original position. Anyone wishing to stake you must do so in exactly the right place.
merits.name: Misplaced Heart

merits.descricao: COORD APPROVAL. You are devoted to a Cause. This devotion manifests as one extra Willpower Trait per story that may only be counted or spent in direct support of a sworn oath or cause.
merits.name: Loyal Heart

merits.descricao: You gain 2 bonus Traits to resist any supernatural powers that cause fear (such as Presence 2). If this power is used on one or more of your battle companions and you are within their line of sight, add 1 bonus Trait for them to resist the effect. Battle Companions are people with whom you have a bond in battle, such as a coterie or those who fight in an orderly fashion according to some tactic, not just anyone who happens to be fighting in your favor in a battle.
merits.name: Infectious Courage

merits.descricao: Due to being over 6'6" tall and over 265 lbs, you have 1 extra Vitality level.
merits.name: Huge Size

merits.descricao: You subtract one Trait from all movement penalties in a combat turn. Additionally, when doing nothing but running (including dodging) in a turn, you may channel your energy to achieve an incredible burst of speed - by spending a Physical Trait, you may take one additional step that turn. Only one Physical Trait may be spent in this way per turn.
merits.name: Natural Runner

merits.descricao: You have one additional Health Level at Bruised
merits.name: Tough Hide

merits.descricao: You gain 2 bonus Traits on tests involving Firearms as long as they do not involve a specific called shot.
merits.name: Crack Shot

merits.descricao: You are excellent with animals – so much so that they constantly seek to befriend you. Wherever you go, animals are happy to see you and, most of the time, happy to help you when you ask for assistance. You receive +1 Trait on Social tests to influence small animals (including Animalism). Additionally, animal companions that have had continued interaction with you see you as a kind of fellow creature and will occasionally bring you small useful things. Once per game session, animals will bring you a useful piece of information or a small item relevant to current events.
merits.name: Critters

merits.descricao: You have managed to acquire a group of pagan worshippers who believe you are one of their deities. More than simply a herd from which you may feed, these devoted followers can perform a variety of tasks for you, from managing your lands during the day to seeking out other vessels to sate your hunger. However, to ensure their devotion, you must make regular appearances to your priests so that their faith in you remains unshaken. It is fitting that you have assumed the role of a war god or death deity, requiring regular blood sacrifices. You have likely ghoulled your most fervent cultists, securing a loyal group of protectors during the daylight hours.
merits.name: Pagan Cult

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: Acquire one Dexterity Trait (Nimble) and gain 1 bonus Trait on tests involving manual dexterity.
merits.name: Thoug as Nails

merits.descricao: The character is considered to have +1 Trait in all Conscience/Conviction challenges.
merits.name: Slowed Degeneration

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: If you suffer the Final Death, your body will instantly burst into consuming flames. This spontaneous combustion ignites flammable objects and inflicts three levels of aggravated damage to anything within 1 step of your remains. As a result, you leave no evidence of your death and may exact a small measure of revenge upon your killer from beyond the grave.
merits.name: Blaizing Demise

merits.descricao: You gain 2 bonus Traits to resist any attempts to frighten or intimidate you (even supernatural threats or fear-based magic, etc). Note: Fearlessness is not the same as stupidity or a robotic absence of reaction. You can still feel emotion or be startled and experience adrenaline surges, still have a sense of self-preservation, and still be capable of acting out of fear. This Merit simply means that it is very difficult to legitimately intimidate or frighten your character. Do not use this Merit to justify idiotic behavior in social situations, breaking the Masquerade/Veil, or other similar foolishness.
merits.name: Fearlessness

merits.descricao:
You are destined for great things in your unlife. Fate has some special purpose for you. This Merit has the following effects:
You have one extra status point when dealing with Cainites who believe in or acknowledge your destiny as something special.
When confronted with a challenge that would prevent you from fulfilling your destiny, you gain 1 Retest. You may do this 3 times per month, but only when dealing with circumstances that would prevent you from fulfilling your destiny (at the Storyteller's discretion).
Once per story, when confronted with terrible and overwhelming circumstances, you may draw strength from the knowledge of your destiny and immediately recover one point of Willpower, even if you have no Willpower remaining.
At the Storyteller's discretion, there may be omens, signs, and prophecies about you, and various forms of divination may reveal your involvement in certain events. There may also be forces acting to obliterate your destiny, and circumstances will tend to conspire to ensure you have the opportunity to fulfill it, so you will never be able to lead a humble and isolated life.
merits.name: Destined to Greatness

merits.descricao: Combat with weapons is natural to you. Swords, knives, klaives, staves, and various other instruments of melee warfare feel like almost second nature. You gain a +1 bonus Trait on Physical tests with Melee Weapons.
merits.name: Battle Prowess

merits.descricao: Your Animalism carries an unusual side effect: it lingers in the minds of the beasts you speak with or control, lending them a certain resistance to others. When another person attempts to command a creature you have previously controlled with Animalism, the difficulty increases by +2
merits.name: Mute Devotion

merits.descricao: Once a year, you may walk outdoors under sunlight. This day is a very significant date (wedding day, anniversary, etc.)
merits.name: Strange Day

merits.descricao: The black streaks of diablerie do not manifest in your aura.
merits.name: Hidden Diablerie

merits.descricao: For every two Blood Points drunk, you absorb 3.
merits.name: Efficient Digestion

merits.fonte: Laws of the Hunt: Players Guide
merits.descricao: You are pitiful; depending on your Nature, it is not affected. When someone challenges you with the intent to harm you, you gain 1 bonus Trait for your defense.
merits.name: Pitiable

merits.descricao: Something about your character attracts the pity of other characters, causing them to treat you like a child. You must decide what is pitiable about you and whether your character cares or not about how they are seen. RP.
merits.name: Pitiable

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: You can store more blood than your generation would normally allow. Each point invested in this Merit increases your maximum Blood Points by one, though it does not increase the rate at which you can process or spend vitae. When you exceed your normal limits, your skin flushes red as if burned, or becomes visibly distended, giving you a grotesque appearance (lose one die on all Appearance-based pools while in this state). Other Cainites (and creatures with heightened senses) can smell the blood trying to seep through your pores. This may incite Frenzy in hungry vampires.
merits.name: Bloat

merits.descricao: Some Cainite owes you a Minor Favor.
merits.name: Debt of Gratitude (1)

merits.descricao: Some Cainite owes you a Major Favor.
merits.name: Debt of Gratitude (2)

merits.descricao: Some Cainite owes you a Blood Favor.
merits.name: Debt of Gratitude (4)

merits.descricao: Gifted by the Muses, you sing sweetly, play an instrument divinely, and speak with passion and eloquence. In all cases, your skill is not so impressive as your delivery. Somehow, everything you say or do rings with power and conviction. In game terms, gain 2 bonus Traits on any social test involving oratory, poetry, music, or song. Naturally, you will make a fine impression wherever you go. People are compelled to speak of such a distinguished individual, and such talk may not always be in the character's best interest…
merits.name: Bardic Gift

merits.descricao: Gain two Traits involving Seduction or Fast Talk. You are extraordinarily seductive. It is not so much that you are fair or quick (though you may be) — you simply possess a certain animal charm that few can resist. Brace yourself for the displeasure of your rivals! People who are not swayed by your charms often hate you for possessing them.
merits.name: Cupid's Gift

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: Spend 1 additional Blood Point — beyond the normal costs of Obfuscate — to sleep invisible. Characters without Obfuscate may acquire this Merit, representing an innate ability that manifests if they ever learn the Discipline.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: As per the Toreador Genre Packet 2018: You were born with unmatched artistic gifts. To create art, the member gains a bonus of two mental attribute Traits on all their tests. With this ability, the member is able to develop artistically on their own, without the need for a tutor (up to the 5th level of a given Artistic Ability).
merits.name: Gifted

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Libellus Sanguinis 2 - Keepers of the Word
merits.descricao: You have access to a mortal with an appearance identical to your own. Whether it is your twin sibling, a distant relative, someone subjected to Vicissitude, or simply someone very skilled at disguise. Unless made into a ghoul, they will age and eventually no longer be able to serve as your double. Your double can walk during the day, conducting your business and maintaining the appearances of a mortal life — but this also involves actions for which you will be held responsible. Remember that your double must be kept informed of your relationships and your affairs.
merits.name: Flech

merits.descricao: You are a seasoned liar and deceiver, capable of fooling even the most skeptical of listeners. You practically exude sincerity. For every two Traits spent on this Merit, up to six, you gain one Trait on all Social Challenges involving deception and manipulation.
merits.name: Downey

merits.descricao: You possess a Drakkar, a boat built to carry warriors. It is not exactly what one would call comfortable and cannot carry much more than 10 or 15 tons of cargo, but it is fast, durable, and perfect for swift raids. It has long keels for better control, yet sits quite shallow in the water. It can pass through most navigable rivers. It is normally propelled by sail, with oars reserved for rivers or emergencies. The ship is steered by a large side rudder and is surprisingly maneuverable. It can sail across or even against the wind. The crew ranges between 24 and 48, and the boat can be rigged for sleeping at sea. Drakkars tend to take on water easily, so the more men aboard the better.
merits.name: Drakkar

merits.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
merits.descricao: Making money comes easily to you, and you know what it takes to succeed in business. You gain 2 Bonus Traits on all tests involving earning money through commerce.
merits.name: Entrepeneur

merits.descricao: Good comic timing is rare, but you have it in abundance; this not only earns you more than your share of party invitations, but your ability to draw out a laugh also means you know what kind of humor to use in any given situation. You are invaluable for maintaining morale and are two Traits up on any Social Challenge to boost morale or ease someone's mood in a useful way.
merits.name: Funny

merits.descricao: Grants 2 Bonus Traits on tests involving balance.
merits.name: Catlike Balance

merits.descricao: You accept defeat and setbacks with uncommon calm. Others find it difficult to provoke your anger through taunts or insults, and you are not greatly disappointed when you fail. You gain +2 Self-Control Traits to resist Frenzy in matters such as personal frustration, humiliation, or provocation.
merits.name: Resigned Spirit

merits.descricao: When you were a child, you thought your name was actually Hey you! It is not that you are necessarily unattractive — it is simply that your face is easily forgotten by those you meet. While this means you will have to work twice as hard as most people to be remembered, it can be a true blessing when you would rather remain anonymous. All difficulties involving recalling your appearance are increased by two Traits. This Merit applies only to your physical appearance; you may have a paper trail a mile long, but fortunately for you, you are unlikely to ever be picked out of a lineup or off a wanted poster. You may not have more than one Social Trait related to positive or negative physical appearance (Beautiful, Repugnant, etc.), nor may you possess more than two Social Traits related to personal charisma; if your totals exceed that level, this Merit must be exchanged for two Bonus Traits.
merits.name: Forgettable

merits.descricao: This is a Merit of dubious benefit. You are prone to the characteristics of religious ecstasy — stigmata, glossolalia (speaking in tongues), visions, and trances, et al. While some may distrust you as a religious hysteric, you will be held in high regard among other Inquisitors as being 'touched by God.' Add 1 Bonus Trait to any test involving social interactions within the Inquisition.
merits.name: Ecstatic

merits.descricao: You have taken the time to study and specialize in a specific enemy of your sect. You know at least some of the customs, strategies, abilities, and long-term goals of the group and can make good use of that knowledge. You gain +2 Bonus Traits on all non-combat tests that pertain specifically to the subject of your specialization. On the other hand, you are at +1 difficulty when dealing with other enemies, simply because you are entirely focused on your particular field.
merits.name: Scholar of Enemies

merits.descricao: This Merit functions identically to Enemy Lore, except that it applies to a group that is not necessarily an enemy of your Sect.
merits.name: Scholar of Others

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: In life, you were a mage, capable of reshaping creation with the force of your will. That power is lost to you forever, replaced by the curse of Caine. Despite this, you have not cut all ties with your former Society. If this Trait is a Merit, some of your mystical associates still speak with you. They will likely not grant access to their libraries or allow you into their sanctums, but they will pass along information from time to time and exchange favors when it is convenient for them. This Trait is extremely rare outside Clan Tremere.
merits.name: Former Magus

merits.descricao: Disciplined fasting hones a thirst for burning blood efficiency. You must let your blood pool drop below your Physical Traits and must go 3 nights without feeding. The next time you feed you gain 2 Blood Points for each point you drink.
merits.name: Excellent Thirt

merits.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: The Long Night
merits.descricao: You may make Ability challenges you do not possess, at the cost of one Trait specific to the challenge (for example, a Mental Trait to make a Security challenge if you do not possess it).
merits.name: Jack-of-All-Trades

merits.descricao: God, Allah, Buddha, any Faith. You gain 1 True Faith, which may be used as True Faith. You may repel other Vampires with a Social Challenge by saying "In the name of XXXX" while brandishing your holy symbol. If you win, the vampire flees, and even if you lose they cannot approach within 10 steps unless they overbid a True Faith challenge against your True Faith. Morality 9 or higher required.
merits.name: True Faith

merits.descricao: When confronted with fear or terror, you plunge yourself into rage. Instead of entering Rotschreck, you may choose to enter a Frenzy of Rage when confronted with fire, sunlight, or other challenges to your courage. However, if you choose to enter Frenzy in this way, you cannot use Willpower to control it.
merits.name: Fear Ferocity

merits.descricao: You do not particularly care whether the biblical Caine is or is not the progenitor of vampires, whether he was cursed by God, or whether God and Caine even exist. You also do not believe in superstitious common wisdom about the Beast. To you it is not a demon or a "demon self"; rather it is the manifestation of a normal and dark human rage, exacerbated by the transformative power of the Embrace. As a result you find yourself at an advantage when fighting the Beast through the keen application of reason. Grants 1 bonus Trait on Frenzy and Rotschreck challenges. Cumulative with Calm Demeanor. Forbidden for Brujahs.
merits.name: Philosophical Humanist

merits.descricao: You have two additional Traits in Social Challenges to intimidate or impress someone.
merits.name: Physically Impressive

merits.descricao: Not everyone is necessarily very attracted to you at first sight, but when you decide to make someone the object of your affection, most people find it difficult to resist. You simply have a talent for understanding the subtle give and take of flirtation and provocation; you are two Traits up in any Social Challenge involving such activity with members of the opposite sex (or of the same sex who find you attractive).
merits.name: Flirt

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: When feeding from you, the victim must make a simple test or feel nausea. If the victim suffers from nausea, they receive a 1 Physical Trait penalty on all challenges.
merits.name: Foul Humors

merits.descricao: Rumors and secrets may be the ruin of polite society, but you simply cannot help yourself — when you have the chance to learn such information, you cannot let it pass. Fortunately, this also means that other gossips recognize you, which means you will rarely have difficulty finding people who want to spread a rumor. Reduce by two the difficulty of all non-violent and non-intimidating Social Challenges related to learning gossip or other minor secrets. (Remember, this is gossip, not state secrets, although you can often compile a surprisingly accurate dossier on a target's life if you connect enough loose ends.)
merits.name: Gossip

merits.descricao: You gain a free retest on any challenge related to resisting cold. You also suffer one fewer level of damage from cold or freezing.
merits.name: The Fire Within

merits.descricao: Lasombra. Powers created by Obtenebration do not dissipate until four hours after sunrise.
merits.name: Strength of Shadows

merits.descricao: Gain 1 Bonus Trait on challenges that attempt to persuade, seduce, or convince based on emotion.
merits.name: Coldly Logical

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: After coming out of Frenzy, make a Static Courage challenge against a difficulty of 3 Traits. With a success, you recover one spent temporary Willpower Trait. Storytellers are advised to restrict Willpower gain through this method to once per night.
merits.name: Cathartic Fury

merits.descricao: While most vampires produce a servile devotion in their ghouls through the "gift" of their blood, creating spiritually and singularly miserable creatures to serve them, your blood reacts differently in some way when granted to the children of Seth (common mortals). With 1 pt, as long as you establish the blood bond and regularly strengthen your thralls, the ghoul's psychological reaction allows for a far greater degree of free will. Your ghouls respect you with fierce loyalty and a powerful sense of affection (like a beloved friend, rather than a dark master), but they do not, as a rule, adopt the pathetic posture of humiliation and fawning. This is not only a more humane form of servitude, more morally acceptable among and by the Prodigals, it also enables your ghouls to more easily pass as normal humans (for example, they are less likely to fly into a rage at someone who curses you). With 3 pts, in addition to the above benefits, they also appear as if they had been the targets of Dominate, with few permanent harmful effects on mortals. And even those conditioned to be perfect servants still possess the spark of intelligence to act reasonably as normal humans.
merits.name: Gentle Enthrallment

merits.descricao: Gain 1 additional Health Level against fire. Gain 2 Bonus Traits on tests that attempt to grapple you.
merits.name: Slimy

merits.descricao: Tremere. You have a natural instinct for the flavors of blood. When you taste blood, you can tell whether the blood is from a vampire, and can automatically sense its potency (generation). There is no test or cost. If the blood is not from a vampire, you only know that much — you cannot specifically differentiate Lupine or faerie blood from human blood without other testing methods.
merits.name: Attuned Taste

merits.fonte: Laws of the Wild: Changing Breeds 1
merits.descricao: You have 2 Bonus Traits on all tests related to making a good impression or recovering from a social blunder. This does not apply to threats, though such grace can be unsettling in its own way.
merits.name: Graceful

merits.fonte: V20 - The Black Hand, A Guide to the Tal Mahe Ra
merits.descricao: Over the years, you have managed to accumulate an exquisite collection of books, both common and rare. Choose 3 points of Lore for every 2 points spent on this Merit, or 10 points of Lore for 7 points. While working within your library, the difficulty rating for any rolls involving those Lores is reduced by 2.
merits.name: Grand Library

merits.descricao: Whether through countless hours of practice or simply a naturally keen understanding of what to say and what people want to hear, you are a fabulous liar. Even the most elaborate untruths carry a touch of credibility when you speak them, and you have no difficulty convincing others to accept your word as truth when you wish. You have 2 Bonus Traits on all attempts to lie or deceive another person. You must have at least six Social Traits to acquire this Merit.
merits.name: Great Liar

merits.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
merits.descricao: You have both influence and contacts within some type of extremist group. It could be a group of nearly insane survivalists with a cause, some prejudiced or terrorist organization. This group provides you with aid and even agents to handle your dirty work. It is possible that this group may even strengthen ties with other similar groups. The more you use these contacts, the weaker they will become.
merits.name: Extremist Group

merits.descricao: If you concentrate on where you want to go and make a Static Willpower challenge vs. difficulty 6, your character can sense the most appropriate and nearest "route" toward your destination.
merits.name: Celestial Guidance

merits.descricao: For some reason, you have visions. The visions are not necessarily precognitive, but like precognition, the visions occur outside of your control. You may become more sensitive to them through ascetic practice, but you will never be able to consciously induce a vision. Then again, you may have visions while walking down the street minding your own business. Unlike Precognition, visions are always steeped in symbolism and apply only to your own un-life. The details of how and when this Merit functions are left to the Storyteller.
merits.name: Mystic Ability

merits.descricao: Once per Session you may make a static Mental challenge Difficulty 8 (or higher according to the Storyteller) to interpret something, a vision, etc.
merits.name: Oracular Ability

merits.descricao: God speaks to you in signs and omens, visions and images. Some visions may be precognitive, while others may be warnings or advice. You cannot request or induce a prophetic vision; they come on their own. These visions range from the obvious to the symbolic; the exact nature and effect of the visions depend on the Storyteller. This merit should provide dramatic moments, and players should not rely on them for plot resolution.
merits.name: Prophetic Ability

merits.descricao: If you are at sea/ocean or within sight of it, you gain one Trait on any Self-Control/Instinct challenge and gain a temporary Willpower Trait.
merits.name: Pelagic Harmony

merits.descricao: Somewhere in your family tree there was a sorcerer, or a half-faerie, or something like that. Purely flavor.
merits.name: Arcane Heritage

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: You have separated yourself from the War of Princes and taken the first step on the bitter journey toward Golconda. The difficulty of all Virtue Challenges is two less than normal. Characters must follow the Virtues of Conscience and Self-Control and have a Path rating of 8 or higher to acquire or maintain this Merit. If you at any point fail to meet these conditions, you will lose your path and the benefits of enlightenment. Storytellers should feel free to inflict automatic degeneration on characters who abuse this Merit.
merits.name: Enlightened

merits.descricao: You have taken the first steps on the steep and thorny path of Golconda. Although you are still far from achieving that state, you understand the proper approach and spend a great deal of time in pursuit of that goal. One Trait would indicate that you know what the word means and are perhaps a beginner. Seven Traits would indicate that you have spent most of your existence seeking Golconda and that you have sufficient knowledge to teach its first lessons to your fellow Kindred.
merits.name: Enlightened

merits.descricao: You cannot be blood bonded, not even partially. Forbidden in most Houses - including ICBN.
merits.name: TBD

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Libellus Sanguinis 4 - Thieves in the Night
merits.descricao: You can store more blood than your generation would normally allow. Each point invested in this Merit increases your maximum Blood Points by one, though it does not increase the rate at which you can process or spend vitae. When you exceed your normal limits, your skin becomes reddened as if burned, or becomes visibly distended, giving you a grotesque appearance (lose one die on all Appearance-based pools while in this state). Other Cainites (and creatures with heightened senses) can smell the blood trying to seep through your pores. This may incite Frenzy in hungry vampires.
merits.name: Blood Bloat

merits.descricao: You do not develop a blood bond with your own blood relatives.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: While other vampires' bodies return each night to the state they were in at the Embrace, any bodily modifications you acquire after the Embrace remain as they are until you actively spend a Willpower point to return your body to its "default" state. This Merit applies to changes as simple as dyeing or cutting your hair, to modifications as complex as tattoos, piercings, or even minor implants. If the Merit allows only aesthetic alterations, it is worth 1 point. If it allows more utilitarian alterations, such as RFID implants that activate certain electronic devices, then it is worth 2 points.
merits.name: Indelible

merits.descricao: You refuse to bow to anyone. You have 6 Traits on any defensive Mental or Social challenge involving Intimidation, Subterfuge, or Stealth as a retrial to control you — such as Dominate. However, this does not apply to emotional control (such as Presence).
merits.name: Untamable

merits.descricao: You are able to ingest food without vomiting - but you do not digest it.
merits.name: Eat Food

merits.descricao: Animals normally flee from vampires, but you are an exception to that rule.
merits.name: Inofensive to Animals

merits.descricao:
You have an innate sense of direction when the destination involves your home or a loved one. When acquiring this Merit, choose a "target" (it can be a location or a character with whom you have a bond - it can be changed, but requires time and RP, and cannot be "established" or "reset" by a simple decision). Once established, you know which direction it is in, no matter where the target may be (even into the Other Worlds, provided you have some means of traveling there).
Important: This quality does not alter your movement speed, means of transportation, or travel complications. You must cover all distances and overcome all obstacles on your own. Assuming you are able to do so, the Homing Instinct will lead you to your destination, despite hundreds of miles or harsh weather. In game terms, you *may need to make* challenges when a major setback or obstacle (a mountain range, a blizzard, a long delay, etc.) blocks your path, at the Storyteller's discretion.
merits.name: Homing Instinct

merits.descricao: Your self-confidence does not come from belief in your own abilities, but from a direct manifestation of the Lord. You have a divine purpose and He works through you, even if your goals may seem anything but holy. Whether due to your powerful will or a genuine connection to the divine, you gain three additional dice to resist the powers of True Faith when they are used against you.
merits.name: Instrument of God

merits.descricao: Grants 2 bonus Traits when attempting to use the Subterfuge Ability to discover someone's Negative Traits if they share the same Nature or Demeanor as you, or when attempting to read that character's aura.
merits.name: Introspection

merits.descricao: With just a few moments of conversation or observation, you can make a fairly accurate assessment of what someone is like, and those assumptions are correct most of the time. You have 2 Bonus Traits on Mental Challenges involving the assessment of someone, and 1 Bonus Trait on any Social Challenge in which you have had limited prior contact with a person.
merits.name: Good Judge of Character

merits.descricao: You simply absorb knowledge! You have a great reputation for being learned, and others seek your counsel. You may add +2 Traits to any Lore challenge. Note: You cannot have Ascendant and Midheaven from the same Ruling Planet.
merits.name: Jupiter Midsky

merits.descricao: You own a Knorr, a larger vessel than the Drakkar, and better suited to merchant ventures than raids. A Knorr can carry between 20 and 40 tons of cargo and has a crew of between 12 and 24 men. The ship is wider than the Drakkar, making it less reliable and slower. Finally, they have far fewer oars and fewer seats for potential rowers, making them less suited for traveling up long rivers to pillage, burn, and trade than the Drakkar. You can raid coastal communities or engage in piracy, of course, but the ship was not built for that purpose.
merits.name: Knorr

merits.descricao: You are extremely devoted to a group or cause. It works the same as True Love, but for a group rather than a single person.
merits.name: Loyal

merits.descricao: You are extremely skilled at sleight of hand and other physical tricks. You gain 2 Bonus Traits when using Subterfuge, Legerdemain, etc. for physical tricks, card games, card tricks, and so on.
merits.name: Legerdemain

merits.descricao: You take half the time to perform any action that primarily involves reading, making you a valuable researcher and investigator.
merits.name: Fast Reader

merits.descricao: Whenever you meet someone for the first time, you may spend a number of Willpower points equal to your Perception Traits. For each point spent, you may ask the Storyteller one question about that character. The Storyteller must answer honestly or allow you to take back the Willpower point to avoid answering the question.
merits.name: Cold Read

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Road of The Beast
merits.descricao: You possess an aura of command about you, a rugged and powerful presence that others cannot ignore. People turn to you, as to a leader, in times of conflict or when physical action is required. Mortals instantly submit to your leadership in moments of tension and conflict. You gain 2 bonus Traits on Leadership, Intimidation, and Etiquette tests in such situations. Other Cainites will be affected by your leadership aura only if they are of a higher generation than yours.
merits.name: Leader of the Pack

merits.descricao: Grants 2 bonus Traits on Leadership tests (including Presence). Must possess at least 6 Social Traits to take this Merit.
merits.name: Natural Leader

merits.descricao: Grants 2 bonus Traits on Leadership tests (including Presence). Must possess at least 6 Social Traits to take this Merit.
merits.name: Natural Leader

merits.descricao: Grants 2 bonus Traits on Leadership tests (including Presence). Must possess at least 6 Social Traits to take this Merit.
merits.name: Born Leader

merits.descricao: If you become blood bonded to someone, that someone will also become blood bonded to you.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: You gain a Bonus Retest on any Social Challenge involving you attempting to wriggle out of a problem, avoid blame, or otherwise escape an embarrassing situation (basically being a lying idiot).
merits.name: Mitanu's Tongue

merits.fonte: Laws of the Hunt: Players Guide
merits.descricao: Spend 1 Trait to gain 2 bonus Traits on tests attempting to discover whether you are lying (does not work against Gifts or Disciplines).
merits.name: Silver Tongue

merits.descricao: Grants 3 bonus Traits on tests related to languages. Doubles the number of Languages learned.
merits.name: Natural Linguist

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: Whenever your Blood Points are completely full, you do not suffer the effects of any derangement. This Merit cannot suppress a Malkavian's primary derangement, although it may alleviate additional madness.
merits.name: Sanguini Lucidity

merits.descricao:
You have trained in a wide range of different combat methods and can apply all of your knowledge to the situation at hand.
System: You identify the weapon traits of your opponent.
merits.name: Diverse Fighting Style

merits.descricao: You do not need to spend Willpower to remain awake during the Day.
merits.name: Early Riser

merits.fonte: Lobisomem o Apocalipse – Guia dos Jogadores do Garou
merits.descricao: You are especially attractive to others. You receive -2 to your difficulty on Seduction or Subterfuge tests. However, this will aggravate other people of your own gender. (Also applies to Animals, if you are a Weresomething).
merits.name: Animal Magnetism

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Libellus Sanguinis 2 - Keepers of the Word
merits.descricao: You have an affinity with another Cainite (most likely a Toreador, but it could be one from any Clan) not acquired through blood bond or other artificial means. You would trust your lives to one another, and you feel empty without the other's presence nearby. This bond can be with someone of the same sex or the opposite sex, and there is no way of knowing who your "soulmate" will be. 3 pts indicate that you can occasionally sense the other's strong emotions (fear, joy, pain) if your soulmate is in the vicinity. 5 pts mean that you frequently sense the other's emotions even at a distance and can feel the other's physical pain or sense if they are in danger.
merits.name: Closer Than Blood

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: Unlike other vampires, you have a distended jaw filled with irregular, knife-shaped fangs. Your bite inflicts 1 additional damage, and you can drain an extra Blood Point each turn while feeding. Unfortunately, your teeth are obviously inhuman and cannot retract. Unless you keep your mouth closed, you suffer a 2 Trait penalty on any Social challenges that do not involve Intimidation.
merits.name: TBD

merits.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: The Long Night
merits.descricao: You have a mansion with at least 25 rooms; this Merit also includes servants to keep it running.
merits.name: Mansion

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: You bear a physical mark that appeared at the moment of the Embrace, similar to a birthmark. This mark is characteristic of your lineage and helps establish credibility as an heir to the power and reputation of your lord's bloodline. Players should discuss the details of the mark with the Storyteller, whether it is an unusual eye coloration, a skin discoloration, or something even more exotic. Whatever the mark, it falls within natural possibilities and/or can be easily concealed, ensuring that mortals do not immediately suspect your undead condition. While this Quality has no system per se, you are harder to impress and your mark may grant status among vampires who know its significance.
merits.name: Mark of Pure Blood

merits.descricao: Gangrel: You are able to control how your Beast manifests more than others. Whenever you gain an animalistic feature, test your current Willpower (difficulty 12 - Humanity rating, maximum 9). If you succeed, you manage to channel your humanity to avoid acquiring an animalistic feature. However, your Beast is further from you, causing you to have +2 difficulty on challenges involving Animalism or Protean (or combination Disciplines involving those powers) for the rest of the night. Vampires on Paths of Enlightenment lose all access to this Quality.
merits.name: Lesser Mark of the Beast

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: Whether as a result of battle wounds or religious practices, your body is heavily adorned with scars. These scars do not interfere with your movements or sensations, nor are they ugly enough to reduce your Appearance. However, anyone who observes you recognizes you as someone intimately familiar with pain and violence. You gain 2 Bonus Traits on Intimidation challenges. As a rule, the city's drunkards are less inclined to pick a fight with you, and most individuals will assume you know how to fight (whether you actually do or not). This Quality may also reflect branding, tattooing, or other rarer markings, at the Storyteller's discretion.
merits.name: Scarred

merits.descricao: The fire of battle runs through your veins and communicates itself through every aspect of your being. Your eyes blaze with the ferocity of an eagle, while your bearing demonstrates your constant readiness for combat. System: While in Frenzy, you gain a Bonus of +2 Traits on Physical challenges (Brawny and Tireless) and deal 1 additional damage. You have +2 Difficulty Traits to resist Frenzy. Note: You cannot have the Ascendant and Midheaven of the same Ruling Planet.
merits.name: Mars Midsky

merits.descricao: You are able to hear the Restless Dead.
merits.name: Medium (2)

merits.descricao: You are able to see, hear, and even sense the Restless Dead. You may be able to deduce their identity or history from your findings and project a strange authority in the spirit world, gaining a Trait on all Social Challenges to intimidate, calm, or persuade a neutral spirit. However, spirits with their own agendas may not particularly respect your power.
merits.name: Medium (4)

merits.descricao: This Quality is interesting for those with mortal lives. Many people go through their entire lives without a true best friend, but you have been blessed with one - through all the ups and downs of life you may have quarreled, but you always stuck by each other, and even after the Embrace you two are still inseparable. She may not know the details of your new life, but she will still do everything she can to help you and will not ask too many uncomfortable questions either. In essence, you have a fully loyal and supportive Ally, but one who also demands more in return, since she naturally expects you to do everything you can for her if she is ever in need as well. Still, when no one else will help you, a best friend will still go the extra mile to save your hide, even if only to kick you a little for being so foolish in the first place.
merits.name: Best Friend

merits.descricao: Many Members become involved with secret societies. While doing so can be dangerous, as your involvement may be seen by some as a threat to the Masquerade, it also offers some very attractive benefits. In addition to providing you with a source of knowledge pertaining to the secret society's area of expertise, this Quality may be used as if it were a single Allies, Contacts, or Herd Trait, in accordance with those Backgrounds, once per session.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: For 1 Willpower and 1 Blood Point, and by acquiring the Negative Physical Trait Lame, you may detach one of your limbs. This can be done multiple times, limited only by the amount of Blood Points and Willpower available.
merits.name: Lizard Limbs

merits.descricao: 1 Turn is enough to memorize a page. You may have a small 'cheat sheet' notebook due to never forgetting anything. If you need to memorize something you were distracted from (due to combat, for example), a static mental challenge Difficulty 6 is required.
merits.name: Eidetic Memory

merits.fonte: Laws of the Wild: Changing Breeds 1
