merits.descricao: Although not literally photographic, your memory is truly impressive. You have 2 bonus Traits on all challenges to recall information and, at any time, you may ask the Storyteller for information about something you wish to remember, although unearthing truly old or minute memories may also require a Simple Test. This Merit does not protect you from supernatural confusion, although you will likely become quite suspicious if your attention is drawn to memories that have been altered or removed, simply because your memory is normally very clear and distinct. This Merit does not provide information you would not have noticed in the first place.
merits.name: Photographic Memory

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Road of The Beast
merits.descricao: You are capable of thinking like a cornered animal, which allows you to predict your prey and anticipate the moves it will make. When hunting in wilderness areas, you gain 2 bonus Traits for the hunt. When hunting mortals, this Merit is somewhat less useful, reducing the bonus to 1 point only. This Merit is useless against any Cainite, regardless of their Road, as all Cainites are predators.
merits.name: Scent of the Beast

merits.descricao: Your Animalism works with insects and other crawling creatures, in addition to mammals. If you select the two-point version of this Merit, your Protean forms may take the shape of an insectoid swarm instead of a single creature (although the swarm must be of equivalent size to a wolf or bat, as appropriate).
merits.name: Hive Mind

merits.descricao: Others may give themselves away when they lie — a stutter, a glance at the floor, a tremor in the voice — all betray the deceit to the would-be unwary. But you do not give yourself away. You are capable of telling barefaced lies and making them appear to be absolutely true. Even veteran priests have difficulty discerning when you are lying. You have 2 bonus Traits on all attempts to lie or deceive another person. You must have at least six Social Traits to acquire this Merit.
merits.name: Talented Liar

merits.descricao: You have an Restless Dead as a guide.
merits.name: Spirit Mentor

merits.descricao: You are a born teacher! But so natural that your teaching sometimes interferes with actually getting anything done. This Merit halves the time required to teach a new Power or Ability, although the Experience Trait cost remains the same. HouseRules ICBN: You do not spend downtime to teach things if you possess this Merit. Note: You cannot have Ascendant and Midheaven of the same Ruling Planet.
merits.name: Mercury Midsky

merits.descricao: You are an unparalleled master of bureaucracy. You may use your Bureaucracy Influence twice as often as normally permitted and in parallel with any other Influence when you go through official channels, as if it were an Influence of that type. However, be sure to cover your tracks, because you will still leave a trail — nobody is that good.
merits.name: Master of Red Tape

merits.descricao: There are many small tics, nervous habits, and autonomic bodily functions (such as breathing) that Kindred simply forget to perform. They may stand unnervingly still or forget to breathe, especially when they think they are alone. You have never let your guard down. The act of breathing remains an unconscious habit for you, and you never fall into that strange, statue-like stillness, even when paralyzed or focused. You gain 1 Trait on all Social challenges when interacting with mortals. This Merit does not allow you to eat food or benefit from the blush of health — those Merits are still required to be a true master of the Masquerade.
merits.name: Master of the Masquerade

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: Storytellers should consider allowing this Merit to be purchased multiple times. For each separate Merit acquired, characters may gain an additional specialization in one of the following Abilities: Academics, Etiquette, Politics, Lore: Sect-Specific (Camarilla Lore for Camarilla characters, Sabbat Lore for Sabbat characters, etc.), Lore: Ventrue.
merits.name: Master of Protocol

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Road of The Beast
merits.descricao: You have studied wolves (or another animal you shapeshift into), or are simply skilled at mimicking their behavior. Whenever you transform into a wolf using Protean, you gain 1 Trait on all Animal Empathy and Animalism challenges to 'infiltrate' a pack of true wolves, and also to activate Animalism to communicate with or control them. To relate to werewolves, this Merit also applies, but only while you are in wolf form. You will still need to somehow conceal your scent.
merits.name: Good Mimic

merits.descricao: Your aim is blessed, like that of David when he cast the stone at Goliath. Your perception of distance and understanding of other relevant factors give you a clear advantage in all ranged attacks. When taking an Aim action (with a ranged weapon with this Merit), add +2 Traits to the Attack (instead of +1).
merits.name: David’s Aim

merits.descricao: When failing a Conscience (and only Conscience) test, you may spend 1 Willpower to retest at one difficulty higher.
merits.name: Compassionate

merits.descricao: You have developed venom glands in the roof of your mouth. The venom is virulent, though Kindred and other supernatural creatures are not affected by it. You, of course, are immune. When you bite, you always inject this venom, usually killing your human victims.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: Gangrel: Your Protean forms are flexible; you may choose a different animal form each time you shapeshift. The form you choose must follow all conventions and rules of the standard Protean animal forms; you may simply choose to appear as a different animal each time you assume the Beast Form.
merits.name: Totemic Change

merits.descricao: The character is as familiar with water as if they were born in it (and perhaps were). Their swimming speed is calculated as if their Athletics rating were 1 point higher, and all tests for actions performed in water are made at +2 Traits. This Merit costs only 1 point for aquatic characters such as the Rokea.
merits.name: TBD

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: A character with this Merit is considered to have +2 Traits when defending against any Presence or magical challenge that aims to influence their emotions. To acquire this Merit, the character must have a Self-Control/Instinct rating of 4 or higher and Willpower of 6 or higher.
merits.name: Unimpressed

merits.descricao: You enjoy the favor of the heavens. Born under a lucky star, you find that fortune and luck follow you wherever you go. Others consider you a natural leader for a sentai and believe they share in your luck when they are near you. Once per session, you may automatically win a test, designating it as a 'lucky' occasion for a non-combat challenge.
merits.name: Auspicious Birth

merits.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: The Long Night
merits.descricao: You have 2 Natures.
merits.name: Double Nature

merits.descricao: You do not feel that you are injured. Ignore the effects of being Bruised and Hurt.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: You have an Exact Sense of Time — useful for musicians, or for returning home before sunrise.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: Whenever you lose a test that could result in your death, you gain a Retest (can be used up to 9 times).
merits.name: Nine Lives

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: Ventrue only: This allows you to make a static Mental Challenge against a difficulty set by the target Mortal's mental Traits. A success allows the Ventrue to determine whether the Mortal is compatible with the Ventrue's preferred feeding type. The challenge may be cast broadly when attempting to 'sniff out' individuals of your preferred feeding type within a crowd.
merits.name: Trained Scent

merits.descricao: Eyes are the windows to the soul. Yours may be the color of golden sunlight or the dark red of glowing embers; or perhaps they bear the yellow gaze of a wolf or lion. System: You have 2 additional Traits on tests involving Leadership, Intimidation, or Empathy.
merits.name: Angelic Gaze

merits.descricao: You gain two Traits on all Mental Challenges related to Reasoning.
merits.name: Mother’s Insight

merits.descricao: You gain 2 bonus Traits on challenges involving your gaze.
merits.name: Enchanting Gaze

merits.descricao: You gain 2 bonus Traits on challenges involving your gaze.
merits.name: Piercing Gaze

merits.fonte: Laws of the Wild: Changing Breeds 1
merits.descricao: Characters with this talent always seem able to pick the right target to follow in a crowd, allowing them to eliminate some of the guesswork from their investigations with a quick Mental Challenge (difficulty depending on the number of people observed and familiarity with who is being sought). With a successful test, the character may ask the Storyteller which character would be most interesting to follow.
merits.name: BirdsEye

merits.descricao: Your vision extends beyond the Shroud of the spirit world and into the lands of the dead. You see and hear the underworld at all times. For you, life is an existence of stumbling through two half-worlds simultaneously - one world of solid, gleaming matter and another of grey, decaying debris. You can also see and hear wraiths and other beings that inhabit the Underworld, and you are a target for such creatures that wish to make contact with the living. Malevolent spectres may stalk you in an attempt to drive you mad. You may acquire the Wraith Lore without the benefit of a mentor.
merits.name: Speaker With the Dead

merits.fonte: Laws of the Wild: Changing Breeds 3
merits.descricao: Organizational tasks, such as data entry and counting grain, are second nature to you, and you can perform them in half the time it would take another person.
merits.name: Organized

merits.descricao: You are not necessarily naive, you simply naturally believe that things will work out. Each time you would recover one Willpower Trait, you recover two instead, as long as you maintain and portray your optimistic outlook.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: You gain +1 bonus Trait to resist Frenzy from anger. Cannot be acquired by Brujah or with the Hot-Headed Flaw.
merits.name: Patience

merits.fonte: V20 - The Black Hand, A Guide to the Tal Mahe Ra
merits.descricao:
Your naturally selective palate allows you to discern specific traits inherent in a blood sample. With just a taste, you can determine the potency, freshness, species, or whether a blood sample is contaminated, as well as attempt to identify the Generation, age, and even the Clan of other vampires. If you taste a single drop of blood, spend 1-3 Mental Traits to acquire the following information:

1 Trait allows you to identify the relative potency and freshness of the blood, a species whose blood you have already tasted and know to be of a specific type, the Generation of another vampire within two steps of your own, whether the blood is less than or more than one hundred years old, and whether it is from your same Clan.
2 Traits identify whether the blood is contaminated by disease or poison, the Generations of vampires within four steps of your own, the approximate age within fifty years (if less than three hundred years old), and any Clan whose blood you have previously tasted.
3 Traits identify specific contaminants you have experienced before, Generations within six steps of your own, the vintage of the blood within twenty-five years (if less than six hundred years old), and any Clan as well as vampire lineage whose blood you have previously tasted.
merits.name: Discerning Palate

merits.descricao: You are more than a connoisseur of vitae, you are an aficionado. Any sip of blood you taste allows a single Mental test against a difficulty of seven Traits, plus one Trait for each hour the blood has aged (retest with Investigation). If you succeed, you may discern distinct qualities in the flavor that can give you clues about the origin of the blood. For example, you might identify Thames river water or know that the victim was a regular opium user who worked in a factory. (You may even be able to detect exactly which factory.) You may also recognize the distinct flavor of a family lineage with which you are familiar. Each use of this Merit allows at least one fact to be learned about the flavor of the blood, though you may learn more at the Storyteller's discretion.
merits.name: Hypersensitive Palate

merits.fonte: The Black Hand, A Guide to the Tal Mahe Ra
merits.descricao: Allows you to acquire one Background above the maximum level for your generation.
merits.name: Paragon

merits.descricao: You have had a long-term relationship (minimum 75 years) with another Member. Although you may have had disagreements over the years, you are generally loyal to one another. You both know each other very well and keep few secrets from one another. You have helped each other many times, and the thought of losing Hider is something you prefer not to consider. The cost of this Merit determines the power and standing of your lover in vampiric society (three for an ancilla, four for an elder of equal stature, and five for a more powerful elder).
merits.name: Paramour

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: Leathery wings fold against your body like a bat or flying squirrel, hanging limply like a tattered cloak when not in use, unless concealed beneath bulky clothing. Although you cannot truly fly, you can glide short distances at your normal walking speed with the aid of updrafts or strong winds. Some dedicated infernalist Gangrel who are severely malformed occasionally manifest a more potent version of this Merit, granting large bat-like wings that span more than five meters from tip to tip. Characters with the 7-point version may fly at a speed of 30 kilometers per hour and perform aerial maneuvers using their Athletics Traits, though they cannot carry objects heavier than half their own weight. Wings of this size can be folded back like an elaborate hood, but cannot be concealed without supernatural means. Gargoyles may not acquire any form of this Merit.
merits.name: Patagia

merits.descricao: Ignores all movement or action penalties due to rough seas or unexpected ship movements.
merits.name: Sea Legs

merits.descricao: You must have at least 6 Social Traits to have this Merit. You gain 2 bonus Traits to break the ice and make a good first impression.
merits.name: People Person

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
merits.descricao: Gain 1 bonus Trait on any test while swimming or moving in water (at minimum up to the torso).
merits.name: TBD

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: For the MET mechanic of this Merit, please refer to the Merit: Danger Sense OWbN Ventrue: Genre Guide 26 of 45 published in MET:LotR (Revised), p.150, which is mechanically very similar for the effects of this Merit. Danger Sense: You have a sixth sense for trouble, and you just know when something is about to happen. If there is a chance you might be surprised by an ambush, you may make a Simple Test. On a win or tie, you may take an action without the hindrance of surprise. The Storyteller determines when this Merit reacts to danger.
merits.name: Meticulous Planner

merits.descricao: You have various resources, sleeper agents, or followers stashed away for a rainy day. For each level of this Merit you have one unassigned background point stored away (2 gives you one point, 3 gives you two points, and so on). At any time, you may spend as many as you wish to increase your level in Allies, Contacts, Herd, Influence, Mentor, Resources, or Retainers. Once spent, the points remain permanently assigned, but until then they cannot be affected by anything. This allows the vampire to create a new resource in an instant, without requiring the expenditure of experience points or waiting through downtime. The vampire is not truly gaining new levels, but rather revealing levels they always had.
merits.name: Secret Stash

merits.descricao: You never leave anything to chance; every action is a carefully considered stratagem. Once per session, you may declare that an action you are about to take is actually 'part of your plan' and reduce its difficulty by 2 (or gain a +2 Bonus). The Storyteller may veto the use of this ability on specific tests. The player and Storyteller should note each such occasion and decide how they are connecting into a grand scheme.
merits.name: Long-Term Planning

merits.descricao: Pure RP. A specialty of the Men in Black; no matter what happens, you maintain a facade of perfect calm. Nothing short of an extradimensional deific manifestation can make you flinch, and even that may not work. The appearance can be deceiving — you may be screaming on the inside, for all anyone knows — but it is quite complete... and very unsettling.
merits.name: PokerFace

merits.descricao: Machiavelli was very clever, but a few more years in the game and you could give the old man a few tips yourself. You understand how power flows through organizations, and whether or not you have real political ability or influence, the arts of deal-making and power brokering come naturally to you. You are two Traits up on all Social Challenges in situations where politics is an important factor, whether it is an international summit or a neighborhood watch meeting. You must have at least six Social Traits to acquire this Merit.
merits.name: Natural Politician

merits.descricao: This Merit halves the time required to learn a new Power or Ability, although the Experience Trait cost remains the same. HouseRules ICBN: You do not spend downtime to learn things if you possess this Merit.
merits.name: Precocius

merits.descricao: You have the ability to perceive events before they happen. This ability is not under your control. Premonitions come to you when you least expect them. The focus of the premonitions is also not under your control. This ability can have a great impact on the story, and the exact nature of the effects is left to the Storyteller. This Merit should not be used to cause problems in the game, but to intensify the experience through additional drama.
merits.name: Precognition

merits.descricao: Gain 2 bonus Traits when performing bite attacks. Your bite deals 1 additional damage.
merits.name: Oversized Fangs

merits.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: The Long Night
merits.name: Special Gift

merits.descricao: You are prescient, meaning you are minutely aware of the workings of fate and have a disturbingly accurate ability to predict the future. Unfortunately, there is no way to control this gift. When choosing this Merit, you must immediately choose the Difficulty for the test to experience your prescient flashes, from 4 to 8. Whenever you wish, you may spend a temporary Willpower Trait and engage in a Static Mental Challenge, retesting with Enigmas, with a Difficulty equal to the one you chose when you selected the Merit. If you succeed, you may importune the Storyteller for information about which course to follow. As this Merit is, in many respects, quite detrimental to the character, the Storyteller should try to give you a good answer in compensation. The more thoroughly you win the challenge, the more complete your awareness of the future will be. If you fail the challenge to see the future, you will see something terrible and (like all future events) impossible to avoid. On the other hand, if you use this Merit, you cannot recover Willpower that night if you succeed, and you cannot recover Willpower for one month if you fail.
merits.name: Foresight

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: Characters may only purchase this Merit once. Characters with this Merit receive +2 Traits on all challenges involving one of their Clan Disciplines (non-Blood Magic), to be determined at the time this Merit is acquired. These bonus Traits may not be used in combat, nor should they be used in Combo Disciplines utilizing that Discipline.
merits.name: Discipline Prodigy

merits.descricao: You receive confusing but prophetic signs and visions. It is up to you to discover whether a specific vision is a warning, a command, or perhaps merely symbolic. Such experiences are frequently accompanied by dramatic physical sensations and devastating headaches.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: You possess several properties that have been in your keeping for years. Most, if not all, have been modified to provide escape routes, daytime shelter, and protection. Examples include castles, museums, apartment complexes, cathedrals, or even a series of underground caves. For each point taken you have two properties.
merits.name: Holdings

merits.descricao: You are remarkably skilled at moving through the underground tunnels you call home. When attempting to navigate, escape, or track through sewers and underground locations you are familiar with, you gain 2 Bonus Traits for each point you have in this Merit.
merits.name: Tunnel Rat

merits.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: The Long Night
merits.descricao: You rely on a network of gossiping mortals who pass information along to you.
merits.name: Spy Network

merits.descricao: Refined Toreadors know the etiquette of their Clan for contacting their superiors. PCs with this Merit have easier access to Toreador NPCs in a given area, such as a newly visited Domain. Note that this Merit grants the PC no advantage beyond the initial contact. They also receive +3 Traits when using the Etiquette Ability.
merits.name: Refined

merits.descricao: Your Obfuscate works against machines, recordings, etc.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: Lasombra: You have a reflection, albeit a weak one. You will appear in mirrors and reflective surfaces, though very faintly and ghost-like.
merits.name: Faint Reflection

merits.descricao: Grants 2 bonus Traits on tests against any form of Magic. This bonus applies to both beneficial and detrimental effects. Forbidden for those with Blood Magic.
merits.name: Magic Resistance

merits.descricao: You have a peculiarly cadaverous appearance that gives you a one Trait resolution penalty on all Social Challenges based on Appearance-related Traits. You should use special makeup to represent the blue around the cheeks and lips, black under the eyes, and a general white around the rest of the face as a good start. However, you do not suffer from the normal Giovanni disadvantage.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: Alcohol, narcotics, and similar addictive substances have little or no effect on you. You may drink from such sources with impunity.
merits.name: Drug Resistance

merits.descricao: Haven't I seen you somewhere before? Gain 1 Bonus Trait on all attempts to persuade, seduce, or deceive a stranger.
merits.name: Friendely Face

merits.descricao: You appear more human than most vampires, which allows you to infiltrate the mortal world more easily. Your skin is rosy, you never stopped breathing (even though you don't need to), and you can even sneeze naturally. You can keep your heart beating as long as you have one Blood Point.
merits.name: Baby Face

merits.descricao: Unlike vampires who grow pale, your skin retains a healthy appearance, being only slightly cold to the touch. This Merit is of great value when interacting with mortals, although you still suffer from the Negative Traits conferred by low Humanity or Path (which are results of your innate monstrousness rather than appearance).
merits.name: TBD

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: When using your chosen Specialty, you receive +2 Bonus Traits when fully dedicating yourself to the pursuit of your obsession. You also suffer -2 Traits on all social challenges and interactions with others while indulging your obsession.
merits.name: Obsessive Savant

merits.descricao: The ghouls you create suffer none of the normal penalties for drinking Malkavian blood — they may drink your blood at will, without any increased chance of developing a derangement.
merits.name: TBD

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: Your blood tastes like the finest wine, naturally sweet, with not the slightest trace of a salty or bitter flavor. As such, you may conceal your blood in a chalice or feed ghouls without revealing the true nature of your "sips".
merits.name: Sweet Blood

merits.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
merits.descricao: Your blood is especially potent. Any Kindred who tastes your blood will find it exceptionally rich and powerful, recognizing your great strength. Any diablerist who tastes it will become addicted. You may create a blood bond with only two drinks of your blood.
merits.name: Strong Blood

merits.descricao: You gain 1 Bonus Trait on social tests when someone is impressed by your lineage. You also gain a bonus Etiquette retest within your lands/domain.
merits.name: Noble Blood

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: The curse of Caine runs strong in your veins. You may spend one more Blood Point per turn than your generation would normally allow. When examined through Aura Reading, your aura is revealed to be far paler than normal.
merits.name: Pure Blood

merits.descricao: When feeding from you, the victim must make a simple test or become nauseated. If the victim suffers from nausea, they receive a 1 Physical Trait penalty on all tests.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: Humans only. Your blood is toxic to vampires; it provides no nourishment (grants no Blood Points) and causes 1 point of lethal damage per Blood Point taken.
merits.name: Poisonous Blood

merits.descricao: Setites only. Your blood is especially delicious to others, Members or otherwise, containing a substance they find physically delightful and addictive. Having drunk your blood, they must drink again, or spend 1 Willpower in moments when they have the opportunity to drink it.
merits.name: TBD

merits.fonte: V20 - The Black Hand, A Guide to the Tal Mahe Ra
merits.descricao: At the cost of one Willpower point, you may feed on the Willpower of your victims at a distance. The consumed Willpower bolsters the potency of your own blood, effectively converting it into temporary blood points that dissipate at the end of the night. These temporary blood points may be spent as normal blood points, but cannot be lost due to damage or blood drain, do not affect hunger tests for Frenzy, and cannot be used to create or sustain blood bonds or ghouls. To activate this ability, the target must have at least one of your blood points in their system and must be within line of sight of you.
merits.name: Psychic Leech

merits.descricao: Everyone considers you pure and innocent. You have 2 bonus Traits when initiating non-aggressive social challenges. This mask could slip one day, you know?
merits.name: Sanctity

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: Vampires with this merit receive +1 Trait on any Self-Control/Instinct challenge to avoid Frenzy when the Frenzy is triggered by the smell, sight, or taste of blood.
merits.name: Controlled Thirst

merits.descricao: COORD APPROVAL FOR NON-TOREADORS. Vampires with this merit receive +3 Traits on any Self-Control/Instinct challenge to avoid Frenzy when the Frenzy is triggered by the smell, sight, or taste of blood.
merits.name: Controlled Thirst

merits.descricao: You see beyond the shroud of Midgard, perceiving the creatures that work beyond the wisdom of ordinary men. Your character automatically sees all chimera and faerie seemings, but will not be affected by them unless enchanted (which does not prevent you from reacting as if they were real!) - see the Changeling setting for more details.
merits.name: Second Sight

merits.descricao: You have no scent. Anyone attempting to track you has 2 fewer Traits.
merits.name: Lack of Scent

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Libellus Sanguinis 3 - Wolves at the Door
merits.descricao: The wild environment is your friend, helping to conceal your passage. You leave no trail to be followed as the earth swallows your footprints and the trees mask your scent. Even magical means of tracking you are inhibited. You pass through places like the wind, leaving nothing behind but a whisper. Even lupines have trouble following you. Normal means of tracking (Survival, use of dogs) automatically fail. Supernatural methods, such as auspices, have a chance but with great difficulty (2 Trait penalty).
merits.name: Without a Trace

merits.descricao: RP. You are treated as if you had one additional Status.
merits.name: Prestige Sire

merits.descricao: You are attuned to the Ether Realm, a condition that allows you to sense when something is not right around you. This makes it easier to avoid being in the wrong place at the wrong time. The Storyteller determines when you receive the warning and whether or not you can determine if the sense of wrongness stems from some kind of astrological phenomenon, celestial event, or disturbance among local spirits.
merits.name: Celestial Sensitivity

merits.descricao: Make a Mental/Perception test (Re-Test with Occult) Difficulty 8. On a success, you know whether any Magic or Discipline is in use or has been used recently within 3 steps of you.
merits.name: Magic Sensitivity

merits.descricao: Whenever a Wraith approaches where you are (in the vicinity or at the location) you may make a Static Mental Test Difficulty 6; on a success you feel a shiver - this merit does not allow you to see or hear the Restless Dead, only to sense their presence.
merits.name: Shivers

merits.descricao: A natural compass, you rarely get lost and seem to have an innate sense of which way is north or where you are (and the distance you have traveled to get there). You can estimate distance and location reasonably well and are two Traits up on all relevant tests to determine where you are or how you got there.
merits.name: Direction Sense

merits.descricao: Dressing well is not just about keeping up with the latest trends and designers, it is also an innate talent for knowing when to dress well (or poorly) and how to do so cleverly, especially on a limited budget. You are one Trait up on all Social tests where your appearance makes any difference, as long as you have time to choose your outfit before going out.
merits.name: Fashion Sense

merits.descricao: You have up to 5 seconds to respond to a declaration of a Physical Challenge to avoid being considered Surprised instead of the normal 3 seconds (As per Laws of the Night Page 200 - Surprise Session).
merits.name: Danger Sense

merits.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: Faith and Fire
merits.descricao: You have a sixth sense for danger. If there is a chance you might be surprised by an ambush, you may make a Simple Test. On a Win or Tie you are not surprised. The Storyteller determines when this quality reacts to danger.
merits.name: Danger Sense

merits.descricao: You have an empathic bond with those you are caring for, gaining +2 Traits on Medicine Tests for Tiebreaker purposes.
merits.name: Emphatic Sense

merits.descricao: As per the Toreador Genre Packet 2018: The member is a true born critic. You know and recognize art in all its forms, anywhere. You receive two additional bonus Traits on all your Art Appreciation tests.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: Grants 2 bonus Traits for the heightened sense.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: The character does not require sight as they possess another sense of equivalent acuity. Typical examples may include sonar such as that of a bat or the sense of smell of a hunting dog. The character does not suffer the usual penalties when acting in total darkness, although strictly visual tasks (such as reading) remain impossible to perform. The character can also identify others through non-visual means. Alternate Senses tend to "pierce" Chimerstry Illusions and Obfuscate concealment, as few Cainites understand inhuman or supernatural senses. When a character with an alternate sense encounters a character using Chimerstry, Obfuscate, or similar powers, consider the character as having an Auspex rating 2 levels higher than they actually possess. For this purpose, a character who does not actually have the Auspex power gains an effective rating of 2. Alternate Senses frequently show some connection to Auspex or to the bodily alterations of Protean, Serpentis, and Vicissitude - and generally occur only in Cainites who suffer from blindness or another extreme debility in their normal senses.
merits.name: Alternate Sense

merits.descricao: You may call for a static mental challenge against 7 Traits to detect the approach of bad weather.
merits.name: Weather Sense

merits.descricao: Grants 2 bonus Traits for the heightened sense. May be purchased multiple times.
merits.name: Acute Sense

merits.descricao: COORD APPROVAL. You may act without penalty in unlit or dark environments. You may also automatically see beyond the Shroud and observe any Wraith in the area (but not hear them; you cannot see a wraith that is using the Arcanoi Manipulation).
merits.name: Cat's Sense

merits.fonte: Laws of the Wild: Changing Breeds 3
merits.descricao: You may not be the most attractive creature around, but you have that indescribable quality that makes you irresistible to others. You might not even be their "type," but your grace, charm, or pheromones turn the opposite sex to putty in your hands. Because of this, you gain two Traits on any Social Challenge that can only be used against those who would normally be attracted to your gender.
merits.name: Sex Appeal

merits.descricao: You gain two Traits in all non-confrontational Social Challenges with members of the opposite sex or members of your own sex who find you attractive, and if you choose to focus the full power of your charms on a single target, you are considered three Traits higher. However, this magnetism may irritate others of your own sexual persuasion - you are considered one Trait lower in Social Challenges with such individuals in any situation where you might be seen as a rival.
merits.name: Sexy

merits.descricao: You have an unusual ability to move silently that goes far beyond the norm. You gain 2 Bonus Traits on Stealth. You are even capable of moving silently over dry leaves. If the wind is blowing while you are in motion, there is no way to hear you.
merits.name: Silence

merits.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: Faith and Fire
merits.descricao: You have an innate sense of the passage of time and the movement of celestial bodies. You can estimate the hours according to the passage of the sun with an accuracy of two minutes and mentally track the phases of the moon. Those who possess this quality in conjunction with knowledge of astrology can even predict certain astrological conjunctions without consulting astronomical tables. It is possible to perform any of these feats with minimal concentration.
merits.name: Celestial Attunement

merits.descricao: You have survived at least one Sabbat attack or recruitment attempt. Your experience helps you anticipate situations in which you may potentially be threatened by the Sabbat once again. You gain 1 Bonus Trait on Mental tests involving Perception when dealing with Sabbat-based matters. This Merit is generally obtained by groups in conflict with the Sabbat, and comes into play most often as a means of avoiding ambushes.
merits.name: Sabbat Survivor

merits.descricao: Others are usually blind to the subtle interplay between people, but you are not. Reading the dynamics of a group or situation is second nature to you, and you can quickly decipher the true feelings people have for one another by studying their vocal tones, word choices, body language, and so on. You gain 2 Bonus Traits in all Mental Challenges involving such interactions between individuals.
merits.name: Socially Aware

merits.descricao: You have dreams during your daytime sleep. Dreams that you remember. Sometimes they even come true. Instead of recovering a point of Willpower, you may choose to have the Storyteller give your character a lucid dream with portents about future events, characters, and situations.
merits.name: Prophetic Dreams

merits.descricao: You suffer no penalties when acting in the morning, regardless of your Morality level.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: You have up to 3 free Retests per Month.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: You gain two Traits in all Challenges directly related to travel (surviving on the road, running long distances, finding food while traveling, NOT being attacked during the journey).
merits.name: Luck of the Road

merits.descricao:
Once per session, you may lower the difficulty of any test by two Traits (minimum difficulty of one Trait), or place two Traits against an opponent; if successful, it is because a small stroke of luck occurs that turns things in your favor.
Alternatively, in a non-test situation, the Storyteller may describe some minor but fortunate circumstance that aids your character, though again this Merit may not be invoked more than once per session.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: Regardless of your upbringing or your etiquette skills, you have such a natural grace and easygoing charm that other people tend to forgive your minor shortcomings, even if they do not actually like you. As long as you are not completely rude or inclined to antagonize others, you are two Traits higher in all Social Challenges to stay on someone's good side in a social situation, such as a party or a nightclub.
merits.name: Smooth

merits.descricao: Anyone who tries to eavesdrop on your conversations or find a hidden object on you has 2 fewer Traits
merits.name: Hidden Talent

merits.descricao: When engaging in danger (at minimum Difficulty 8 with some Detrimental Effect - or in combat facing someone far superior to you or at a numerical disadvantage) gain 1 Trait on the test.
merits.name: Daredevil

merits.descricao: Grants 1 bonus Trait for Self-Control/Instinct and Courage tests. Forbidden for Brujahs.
merits.name: Calm Heart

merits.descricao: Your psyche flows with the permutable nature of change. Like the multiform Dracon, you are a whirlwind of temperaments. This is not a matter of multiple personalities. You are an identity shown through the prism of ever-changing Natures. No anchor restricts your sense of identity. You can be anyone. At the beginning of each story, you may choose a Personality Archetype to function as your Nature, spending the rest of the story perceiving the world through that perspective.
merits.name: Dracon’s Temperament

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Libellus Sanguinis 2 - Keepers of the Word
merits.descricao: Your art is considered truly inspired and leaves audiences enthralled. Characters with this merit receive +3 Traits on challenges related to Performance and Crafts. If the art produced is related to God, the Church, or similar lofty ideals, players may add one free level to their artwork, not exceeding level 6. Such perfection will not go unnoticed and may draw unwanted attention from both the mundane population and other supernatural creatures.
merits.name: Touched By God

merits.descricao: Perhaps you are tough or have numbed your nerves through Vicissitude. Perhaps your master put you through so many intricate hells that it would be hard for anyone else to compete. Maybe it simply excites you. You suffer no penalties for Bruised or Wounded - you continue to suffer the effects of Incapacitated and below. You must have a Conviction or Courage rating of 3 or higher to obtain this Merit.
merits.name: Pain Tolerance

merits.descricao: Normally a vampire heals the bite of the kiss by licking the neck. With this touch you do the same.
merits.name: Healing Touch

merits.descricao: You have an informant embedded in one of your sect's enemy organizations who channels all kinds of information to you about what their associates are doing. What you do with the information is up to you, but abusing the knowledge can be a good way to get your informant killed. The other side has spies too….
merits.name: Mole

merits.descricao: You gain 1 bonus Trait on tests involving bodily flexibility (such as escaping handcuffs, climbing, etc.)
merits.name: Double-Jointed

merits.descricao: CORD APPROVAL. You receive 1 free Intimidating Social Trait, this Trait may take you above your Generation limit. You also gain 2 Traits on any social challenges involving a bad attitude (intimidation challenges).
merits.name: One Bad Dude

merits.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
merits.descricao: You have control over a university. The staff and officials serve your interests. You have full access to the facilities and may hunt freely on campus. The professors and libraries are useful in providing research information. The campus also has many computers and people who know how to use them.
merits.name: University

merits.descricao: Female characters only. You have chosen to take on the traditional male warrior role in Scandinavian society. More importantly, you have defeated (and killed!) notable men in holmgangas (Nordic duels), and your status is recognized. You have more trouble with men and women trying to lure you into their beds than with young warriors trying to prove their manhood by killing you. Add a +2 Trait bonus to all your social challenges within a Scandinavian society - or of this culture / Viking Culture.
merits.name: Walkurie

merits.fonte: Laws of the Hunt: Players Guide
merits.descricao: You have an affinity for working better with a specific item, in a specific place, or with a specific person. You gain up to +2 additional Abilities or up to 1 attribute Trait. Must be observed with the Storyteller.
merits.name: Home Advantage

merits.descricao: You possess a powerful charisma that makes you a natural leader, capable of inspiring others to follow you out of love and admiration! Lovers easily enter your life and friends seek you out. You gain +2 Bonus Traits on Social Tests involving Charisma. Note: You cannot have the Ascendant and Midheaven of the same Ruling Planet.
merits.name: Venus Rising

merits.descricao: You have a great ability to act as an intermediary or mediator between opposing factions. You have a soft voice, are calm by nature, and can calm people down before they erupt. People enjoy listening to you, and so they do! When declaring that you will act as a mediator, you gain 3 Temporary Willpower Points and +3 bonus Traits to avoid Frenzy for the duration of the scene. However, you may not use powers while mediating. Note: You cannot have the Ascendant and Midheaven of the same Ruling Planet.
merits.name: Venus Midsky

merits.descricao: By winning a Static Mental Challenge Difficulty 7, you may see ghosts and even vaguely distinguish the lands of the Underworld for the remainder of the scene.
merits.name: Ghostsight

merits.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
merits.descricao: You have traveled around the world, seen many different cities, and encountered many members. There is a chance you will recognize the name of a vampire from another city when you hear it. This is a Mental test (difficulty 10 minus the vampire's status).
merits.name: Well-Traveled

merits.descricao: Whether through extensive book learning, much time spent elsewhere, or a combination of both, you are well-versed in finding your way in distant places, from travel within your country to foreign lands. For two Traits, this applies to anywhere you travel within your home country; for four Traits, the world is yours to explore. Whenever you are attempting to find food, shelter, transportation, or other basic goods and services in another location, lower the difficulty of any appropriate test by two Traits. Note that this confers no automatic benefits regarding any language barriers that may exist, though a hunter with this Merit may more easily locate a translator in places where they do not speak the language.
merits.name: Seasoned Traveler

merits.descricao: From TV programs to radio call-ins and online chat groups, you are an avid consumer of pop culture, and if anyone is up to date on the latest movies or music, it will be you. Although this can consume your downtime at an almost unhealthy level, you are two Traits up on all tests related to researching anything connected to pop culture or on all Social Challenges involving fellow devotees of these media.
merits.name: Mídia Junkie

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Libellus Sanguinis 1 - Masters of State
merits.descricao: A character with this Merit gains +2 Bonus Traits on combat challenges against the target of their vengeance. Storytellers should take care to ensure that this target has truly done something worthy of such vengeful hatred, and should feel free to force the character to spend temporary Willpower Traits when they feel the character is not being persistent enough in pursuing the target of their hatred. It is also suggested that the Storyteller allow this Merit to focus on only one individual at a time.
merits.name: TBD

merits.descricao: You are extraordinarily sensitive to the use of supernatural powers of illusion, deception, and disguise, and can see through them to the heart of the matter. With a successful Mental Challenge, you can see through Unseen Presence, Mask of a Thousand Faces, Chimerstry, and the like. When facing multiple opponents simultaneously, you need only risk a single Mental Trait to attempt to perceive all of them; make a single test against all of them simultaneously, resolving ties normally. If you lose any of the challenges, you lose only the Mental Trait you bid.
merits.name: Clear Sighted

merits.descricao: Due to some innate ability or your long exposure to vampires, you are aware, on a visceral level, of their inhuman nature. Upon meeting a vampire, possibly even from the first glance, you can immediately sense that your new acquaintance bears the mark of Caine. This perception is not always accurate, depending on the Storyteller's judgment.
merits.name: Uncanny Sight

merits.descricao: You gain 2 bonus Traits on any Enigmas Challenge.
merits.name: Inner Sight

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: At any time, you may invert the spectrum of light and dark for your vision. This requires one turn of concentration and a Static Mental Test Difficulty 7 (Re-Test with Alertness). With Tenebrous Vision active, you can see in total darkness as though it were brightly and evenly lit, while torches emit a glare that obscures perception in the same way that darkness interferes with normal senses. The meaning of colors also inverts, lending a surreal tone to the world without interfering with your ability to distinguish hues. All penalties for partial darkness apply to dim lighting, and the absolute void of sunlight and equally brilliant glare blind you (and burn you, in the case of sunlight). This Merit does not allow you to see through mystical shadows, such as those produced by Tenebrae.
merits.name: Darksight

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: You gain +2 Traits on all Expression and Crafts tests, and other tests requiring creativity, at the Storyteller's discretion. You also lose -2 Traits on all challenges involving repetitive or menial tasks.
merits.name: Artful Visionary

merits.descricao: Make a Physical challenge against the target to humiliate them by vomiting on them.
merits.name: TBD

merits.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
merits.descricao: When affected by Dominate, you may spend 1 Willpower for a retest. If you win, the effect is negated (and you gain the usual 5-minute immunity). If you are the target of any magic or power (such as Dominate) that alters your mind, you gain 3 bonus Traits to defend yourself.
merits.name: Iron Will

merits.descricao: When affected by Dominate, you may spend 1 Willpower for a retest. If you win, the effect is negated (and you gain the usual 5-minute immunity). If you are the target of any magic that alters your mind, you gain 3 bonus Traits to defend yourself.
merits.name: Iron Will

merits.descricao: Grants 2 bonus Traits on tests involving your voice.
merits.name: Soothing Voice

merits.descricao: Grants 2 bonus Traits on tests involving your voice.
merits.name: Enchanting Voice

merits.descricao: CORD APPROVAL. You automatically succeed on non-combat swimming tests, and have 2 bonus Traits on any challenge in the water. In exchange, you have 1 fewer Trait on any Physical Challenge on dry land.
merits.name: Water Baby

merits.descricao: CORD APPROVAL - OR GANGREL PACKET. You possess a natural affinity with spirits, whether natural spirits such as animals or plants (Shaman). Although you cannot see spirits unless they reveal themselves, you may speak freely with any spirit of your affinity in the area, and may even summon them through pleas and persuasion. However, spirits never offer their powers or advice for free - they always want something in return.
merits.name: Shaman

flaws.descricao: Your total blood is 10, but you can only use 8. Purchase the Thin Blood Flaw.
flaws.name: 14th Generation

flaws.descricao: You can only take 1 step per action - use of a Cane is mandatory.
flaws.name: Lame

flaws.descricao: You have some curse - speak with the Storyteller.
flaws.name: Cursed

flaws.descricao: You are screwed. The Storyteller may hide your character sheet from you.
flaws.name: Amnesia

flaws.descricao: You are unable to Read and Write. (Could also represent Dyslexia)
flaws.name: Illiterate

flaws.descricao: You automatically fail any tests involving smell and taste. (Auspex does not function through these senses)
flaws.name: Anosmia

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: You gain the Gangrel Clan Flaw Wandering Lineage (You cannot remain in the same location for more than 3 days, otherwise you suffer a +1/day penalty on your tests)
flaws.name: Munderlust

flaws.descricao: Perhaps you belong to a specific group - gothic, punk, raver, etc. - or perhaps you simply have a truly unique sense of style, but either way, your appearance immediately makes you stand out in a crowd (at least among more common people). In addition to occasionally attracting the negative attention of others who disapprove of your group or style, you are also easily remembered by other people. Any attempt to track you through witnesses has two additional Traits. Obviously, this Flaw also requires that you wear clothing and makeup appropriate to mark your unique appearance, and repeated failure to do so will force you to pay off this Flaw.
flaws.name: Eccentric Appearance

flaws.descricao: No matter how old you are, you appear to be underage for many adult activities and can count on the possibility of being questioned, dismissed, and harassed by those who believe you are nothing more than a minor. You have a 1 Trait penalty on all attempts to persuade others that you are in fact of legal age, as well as on all Social Challenges with those inclined to distrust the young (concert bouncers, cynical police officers, etc.). If you do not already have an appearance that simulates this Flaw, we recommend a description tag to alert other players of your apparent youth.
flaws.name: Youthful Appearance

flaws.descricao: There is no ecstasy in your Kiss.
flaws.name: Grip of the Damned

flaws.descricao: A Restless Dead Haunts you.
flaws.name: Haunted

flaws.descricao: The Gift Scent of the Wyrm automatically flags you - exclusive to Setites.
flaws.name: Aura of the Outcast

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: You radiate supernatural power. Perhaps you were a mage in life, inadvertently fed upon someone of the Fair Folk, or studied the twisted sorcery of the Tremere. All attempts to sense magic on or around you gain 2 Bonus Traits. Your aura also shows the shimmer of magical use to Aura Reading and similar powers, as long as the observer scores at least one success. Assamites of the sorcerer caste may not take this Flaw.
flaws.name: Mistical Aura

flaws.descricao: Money makes the world go round, and you intend to ride the carousel for all it is worth. Everything is secondary to the pursuit of wealth, and you are capable of doing some extreme things as long as there is enough money in it for you. Whenever you are offered a bribe, even from a monster or other repugnant figure, you must spend a Willpower Trait or make a Willpower test against six Traits to avoid accepting the bribe. This difficulty increases by one if you are certain the required task will not harm anyone (that you know of). Additionally, you must make a similar test to avoid searching the bodies or residences of fallen opponents for valuables, or looting fallen allies for the same.
flaws.name: Moneygrubbing

flaws.descricao: Once per session, the Storyteller may add 2 Traits to the difficulty of a test, and if you fail, it is due to some completely random and wholly unfortunate factor that suddenly arises. Additionally, you seem to be the target of a minor but endless stream of karmic jokes, which the Storyteller will likely evoke descriptively as the chronicle progresses.
flaws.name: Unlucky

flaws.descricao: If another predator (Vampires, Lupines, etc.) enters your territory uninvited, you must test Self-Control/Instinct to avoid entering Frenzy.
flaws.name: Parochialism

flaws.descricao: Whenever you make a test that you believe you will fail (at the Storyteller's discretion), you suffer a 2 Trait Penalty on the test. (You may spend 1 Willpower to negate the penalty.)
flaws.name: Low Self-Image

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: Every time you fix your gaze upon a reflective surface, you see the Beast glaring sideways back at you. If this horror is visible only to you, this Flaw costs only one point. If the mirror betrays your monstrous nature to anyone who looks, this Flaw is worth two points. Even at the one-point intensity, mages and other gifted souls may occasionally catch a glimpse of your true nature for a moment. Even ordinary mortals may sense that something is faintly wrong with you. Gain 2 Penalty Traits on any Social tests (except intimidation) with mortals who have seen your reflection.
flaws.name: Beast in the Mirror

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: Some part of your withered soul recognizes its own damnation. Perhaps your Beast regrets its hunger, or your self-destructive impulse overrides its instincts. Whenever you are in a position to test Rotschreck, test Courage normally. However, a failure does not lead to Red Fear. Instead, you seek out the source of danger and embrace destruction — snatching a torch by its flames or flinging yourself into sunlight. It is possible for characters with this Flaw to develop 'normal' survival instincts, but it will never be easy.
flaws.name: Suicidal Beast

flaws.fonte: Laws of the Night: Camarilla Guide
flaws.descricao: You are always accompanied by a cold and unsettling breeze.
flaws.name: Cold Breeze

flaws.descricao: You suffer a 1 Trait penalty on Self-Control/Instinct tests. Cannot be taken by Brujahs.
flaws.name: Hot-Headed

flaws.descricao: A Hunter (or group of hunters) is on your trail.
flaws.name: Hunted

flaws.descricao: You suffer 2 Penalty Traits on tests involving perception and depth — including ranged attacks.
flaws.name: One Eye

flaws.descricao: You have a permanent physical mark that is easy to remember — a prominent tattoo, scars, or a birthmark. Not only does this make it easier to identify you, but all attempts to locate you based on witness interviews increase by a number of Traits equal to the value of this Flaw. This Flaw is worth one Trait if the feature can be easily covered by clothing, two Traits if it cannot, and must be represented by appropriate makeup or description cards.
flaws.name: Distinguishing Characteristic

flaws.descricao: Spectres can see you normally through the Shroud, and can cause problems with that.
flaws.name: Spectre Meat

flaws.descricao: Blind. Loses ties where vision is a determining factor (manual dexterity, for example). Automatically fails vision-based tests. Generally cannot be affected by Dominate, but can still use Aura Perception.
flaws.name: Blind

flaws.descricao: You suffer a 1 Trait Penalty on social interactions with Mortals.
flaws.name: Smell of the Grave

flaws.descricao: Nothing says your sense of style isn't perfectly fine, but your sense of occasion could definitely use some improvement, at least when it comes to what you should — and shouldn't — wear depending on the situation. Whether due to work restrictions, wardrobe limitations, or sheer force of habit, you always seem to be caught wearing high heels when you need to chase someone, or tight clothing that restricts your movement when you're trying to climb a chain-link fence. You are assumed to begin each session somehow dressed in a manner completely inappropriate for physical scenes, and are therefore considered to have a 1 Trait Penalty related to athletics or combat, unless you specifically acquire extra clothing in-game and take the time to change during the game/session. This Flaw should be simulated as safely as possible with appropriate costuming, but if you ignore or easily circumvent this Flaw too frequently, you may be required to buy it off, as it is obvious you have finally learned to dress appropriately for any occasion.
flaws.name: Impractical Dresser

flaws.descricao: Whatever intangible quality makes people open up to others, you simply do not have it. No matter what you are like on the inside, you habitually project a cold and hostile demeanor to those around you, and most don't bother trying to get to know you any better than that. You are two Traits down on all Social tests with someone during the first scene in which you meet them, due to your innate difficulty in presenting a pleasant face to others. This differs from the Negative Trait Callow, as it represents an ineptitude at presenting yourself well rather than actual emotional isolation, although the two may be combined to create a truly heartless and distant S.O.B.
flaws.name: Icy Demeanor

flaws.descricao: Saving money is difficult when there are so many cool things to buy, and you tend to overextend your finances by purchasing brand-name goods and a host of products you don't really need. Add two Traits to the difficulty of all tests related to the use of your Resources, and reduce by one third the value of the monthly allowance it would normally provide, to reflect the amount of money you spend.
flaws.name: Conspicuous Consumer

flaws.descricao: You become confused when exposed to excessive stimuli (very crowded and noisy places). You receive a 2 Trait penalty when in such locations. You may spend 1 Willpower to ignore this penalty for one scene.
flaws.name: Confused

flaws.descricao: Must purchase Eat Food. You need to eat liver/heart/kidneys in order to drink blood.
flaws.name: Conspicuous Consumption

flaws.descricao: Living in close proximity to you is capable of spreading dangerous diseases (the Black Plague, anyone?).
flaws.name: Contagious

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
flaws.descricao: You gain the True Brujah Clan flaw.
flaws.name: Atrophied Heart

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Road of The Beast
flaws.descricao: You have the Brujah Clan flaw — cannot be acquired by Brujahs.
flaws.name: Heart of the Beast

flaws.descricao: Spend 1 Willpower to cause pain or suffering to someone. You must have Humanity 4 or higher to have this Flaw.
flaws.name: Soft-Hearted

flaws.descricao: Having removed your heart with the fifth level of Serpentis, you have lost it! The heart may be in the possession of an enemy, or simply lost.
flaws.name: Lost Heart

flaws.descricao: You are incredibly cautious around strange people and, worse still, around crowds. You suffer a 1 Trait penalty on all Social Challenges with people you do not know, and a 2 Trait penalty on all Social Challenges addressing a crowd of any kind (+10 people). And yes, these penalties are cumulative for crowds composed of more strangers than familiar faces.
flaws.name: Chronically Shy

flaws.descricao: You cannot cope with the fact that you need blood to stay alive. You must pass a Courage test every time you feed, or you will be unable to go through with it.
flaws.name: Guilt-Wracked

flaws.descricao: Healing 1 lethal costs 2 Blood Points. You can only heal 1 Aggravated per Week.
flaws.name: Slow Healing

flaws.descricao: You cannot resist mysteries or puzzles of any nature, and when confronted with a situation in which you might be tempted to investigate, you must make a Static Mental Challenge against a number of Traits determined by the Storyteller. You may resist the temptation while spending a Willpower Trait, but if another mystery comes along...
flaws.name: Curiosity

flaws.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: The Long Night
flaws.descricao: This flaw prevents you from seeing colors; you see only white, black, and shades of gray (this is not quite how real color blindness works).
flaws.name: Color Blindness

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
flaws.descricao: You have already begun to fall into the Beast's clutches. Reduce your starting Path score by one point for each point gained from this flaw.
flaws.name: Degenerate

flaws.descricao: Nobody puts you on guard duty unless they have no choice, and you are likely to be the first to fall asleep during planning sessions — you cannot help it, but it is practically impossible for you to stand still and pay attention to anything for any length of time. If you are ever required to perform an action that demands more than ten minutes of constant supervision, such as standing guard outside a stronghold or watching for signs of activity at a monster's lair, you must make a Willpower test against six Traits. Failure means you become distracted in some way; you do not have to abandon your post immediately, but you suffer a two-Trait penalty for the rest of the scene on all Perception-related tests due to your inattentiveness.
flaws.name: Attention-Deficit Disorder

flaws.descricao: You suffer a 2 Trait penalty on Hearing tests.
flaws.name: Hard of Hearing

flaws.descricao: You suffer a 2 Trait penalty on Vision tests when not wearing glasses or lenses.
flaws.name: Bad Sight

flaws.descricao: You suffer a 2 Trait penalty on Vision tests.
flaws.name: Bad Sight

flaws.descricao: You suffer a 1 Trait penalty on physical interactions and 2 on Social interactions.
flaws.name: Deformity

flaws.descricao: Due to your square teeth, you must make a Physical test to sink your teeth into someone's neck.
flaws.name: Blunt Fangs

flaws.descricao: Appearance 0. You suffer a 2 Trait penalty on Social tests other than Intimidation.
flaws.name: Disfigured

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: Your Beast hungers for more than blood. Every time you feed, you steal one Willpower point from your victim for every three Blood Points taken. Unfortunately, your parasitic soul cannot sustain itself by any other means. You cannot recover Willpower by any other method. Worse still, you must spend one Willpower point each night after awakening or lose one permanent Willpower point. If your permanent Willpower drops to zero, you suffer the Final Death, your body decaying to ash as your parasitic soul feeds upon itself. Characters with this Flaw do not need to spend Willpower while in torpor.
flaws.name: Soul Eater

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: Unlike other Cainites, you gain no sustenance from the tasteless blood of animals. Only the blood of mortals and other vampires can sustain your unlife. This Flaw often manifests in many vampires as they age, a prelude to the cannibalistic Thirst of Caine.
flaws.name: Dieta Restrita

flaws.descricao: Stutter or Tourette's. You suffer a 2 Trait penalty on tests involving speech.
flaws.name: Dificuldade na Fala

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
flaws.descricao: For every two Blood Points drunk, you absorb 1 - Blood from Cainites still provides you full benefit, which may lead you toward the forbidden thirst of Amaranth.
flaws.name: Poor Digestion

flaws.descricao: Although not necessarily stupid or uneducated, you have a tremendous difficulty reading the printed word, so that even the simplest documents often take a great deal of time to work through. You are two Traits down on all tests to decipher maps or read documents of any kind, and such activities take half the time they would take another character to reflect the additional difficulty you have when working with such sources.
flaws.name: Dyslexic

flaws.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: The Long Night
flaws.descricao: You forget names, appointments, etc. You must win a Static Mental Challenge with a difficulty determined by the Storyteller to remember anything beyond your own name, address, and phone number during stressful situations.
flaws.name: Absente-Minded

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
flaws.descricao: You gain the Toreador Clan Flaw.
flaws.name: Enraptured by Beauty

flaws.descricao: Animals are very fond of you. Every night when you rise from your slumber, they are there waiting. They follow you as a group, looking to you for leadership. They gather from the surrounding areas, usually all creatures of one particular type congregating during the day around your resting place. They disperse while you sleep only to reunite with the coming of night. With 2 pts the affected animals are small like rats and mice, which may go unnoticed. With 3 pts they are larger and draw more attention, such as cats. With 4 pts you are followed by creatures that are difficult to ignore such as wolves, bears, or deer. People may use this to locate your haven or track your movements, and it makes it difficult for you to avoid detection if you remain in the same place for too long.
flaws.name: Pied Piper

flaws.descricao: During your Embrace, a portion of your skin turned to scales. If it is only a small area, easily hidden, such as a patch of skin beneath your clothing, this is a one-point Flaw. An entire affected limb, such as an arm, forcing you to wear gloves and coats, is two points. A lipless and scaly face is a three-point Flaw.
flaws.name: Escamas

flaws.descricao: Yes, yes, we have all heard how much you appreciate the fine arts, classical music, the finest wines, and the sublime atmosphere of a good French restaurant - the problem is that we have also heard how much abuse you heap upon those who display the slightest knowledge or enjoyment of pop culture. In short, it is obvious to everyone that you are a cultural snob of the worst kind and must do your best to roleplay this unpleasant distaste for all things "popular" as accurately as possible. Furthermore, when it comes to dealing with people who are not equally snobbish about such things (read: almost everyone), you are two Traits down on all Social Challenges.
flaws.name: Cultural Snob

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: You are too strange or unsettling to forget. You may have distinctive features or a mystical aura, but the effect is the same: anyone attempting to locate you through Investigation receives 1 bonus Trait per point invested in this Flaw. Fortunately, Creepy does not interfere with active Stealth attempts. However, you always stand out in a crowd and cannot hide in anonymity. Even characters with Obfuscate must contend with your attention-worthy appearance, unless they spend extra Traits when activating Obfuscate to temporarily cancel the Creepy penalty on a one-for-one basis.
flaws.name: Uncanny

flaws.descricao: You may only take 2 steps to move with an action.
flaws.name: Estatura Baixa

flaws.descricao: You lose 1 extra Blood Point when you awaken. You suffer a 1 Trait penalty on social challenges due to the stigmata.
flaws.name: Stigmata

flaws.descricao: You lose 1 extra Blood Point when you awaken. You suffer a 2 Trait penalty on social challenges due to the stigmata. You suffer a 1 Trait penalty on challenges involving vision due to constantly weeping blood.
flaws.name: Stigmata

flaws.descricao: You have a highly sensitive palate for vitae, so much so that you scoff at the idea of absorbing vitae from mortals you consider unsuitable in all but the most dire of circumstances. Exactly what it is about this blood that you find so disagreeable may vary — perhaps the poor health of the lower classes produces a horrible taste, or perhaps you despise the cloying, sickly flavor of the pampered aristocracy. Choose one type of vitae that you find unpleasant for the purposes of this Flaw (subject to Storyteller approval, of course). This Flaw cannot be combined with the Prey Exclusion Flaw and is more than merely a matter of distaste. To keep down any blood from a source you consider unsuitable, you must make a Physical challenge against a difficulty of eight Traits (retested with Survival) for each Blood Trait of the offending type you wish to retain. Anything else is immediately and messily regurgitated. Ventrue cannot take this Flaw.
flaws.name: Frail Stomach

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: In life, you were a mage, capable of reshaping creation with the force of your will. That power is lost to you forever, replaced by the curse of Caine. Despite this, you have not severed all ties with your former Society. If this trait is a Flaw, your former associates view you as a liability. They may not actively hunt you (unless you take the Enemy Flaw), but they regard you as a monster and a traitor and will treat you accordingly. This trait is extremely rare outside Clan Tremere.
flaws.name: Former Magus

flaws.descricao: You are, in a word, jaded. You have seen and done everything, at least twice — probably more than that, in whatever pleases you most — and virtually nothing makes you cry out in orgasmic satisfaction anymore. Needless to say, getting an impetuous or violent reaction out of you requires more than it does for most, and your Beast, unfortunately, is just as bored with the simpler and more common perversions as you are. Your inner monster grows restless frequently and is difficult to control, and you have begun searching for some pastime exotic enough to keep your Beast entertained. Unfortunately, you have not yet been able to find such a pastime. And fortunately, you have started to enjoy the search a little. Because your Beast is so restless and irritable, you suffer a 2 Trait penalty on all tests to resist Frenzy and to control it (Instinct) once it has already begun.
flaws.name: Faded

flaws.descricao: Perhaps you are a talented and somewhat self-assured individual, or perhaps you are simply a show-off with a wholly unfounded opinion of your own merit, but either way you tend to underestimate your opposition while overestimating your own capabilities. Once per session the Storyteller may secretly add +3 Difficulty Traits to a test to reflect how your inflated opinion of yourself led you to draw the wrong conclusion about your situation. You also tend to be reckless.
flaws.name: Overconfident

flaws.descricao: You do not feed from a specific type of mortal. If you do feed from them, you must make a Conscience/Conviction test Difficulty 4 or enter Frenzy. If you witness someone feeding from your Prey Exclusion, you must make a Self-Control/Instinct test Difficulty 4 against the target. Forbidden for Ventrue.
flaws.name: Prey Exclusion

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: The Inner Beast emerges in times of hunger or stress, twisting your features into a monstrous caricature of the human form. You may not have more Appearance Traits than your current Blood Points. Additionally, you must test Self-Control (Difficulty 3) every time you are subjected to stress, in addition to any test for Frenzy. If you fail, you gain Monstrous for the rest of the scene. Characters with this Flaw who follow Instinct automatically assume their bestial features when provoked, as do those who actually succumb to Frenzy.
flaws.name: Face da Besta

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Road of The Beast
flaws.descricao: You have the Gangrel Clan Flaw — cannot be taken by Gangrel.
flaws.name: Face of the Beast

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: Your aura always shows the blackened marks of the Amaranth, even if you have never committed diablerie. Perhaps your sire was a habitual diablerist, or perhaps, in the agonies of Frenzy, you nearly committed the heinous act yourself. Assamites of the warrior caste may not take this Flaw.
flaws.name: Falso Amaranto

flaws.descricao: You emit an aura of evil. Priests and mortals who possess Faith become aware that you are a creature of darkness. You suffer the effects of Faith when on holy ground or any place of worship.
flaws.name: Farol Profano

flaws.descricao: Lose all ties in stealth tests due to your foul odor.
flaws.name: Fedor

flaws.descricao: At some point in the past you suffered a serious injury, and it continues to hurt to this day - you suffer a 1 Trait penalty on all Athletics tests due to the discomfort, and must roleplay dealing with this old war wound accordingly.
flaws.name: Old Injury

flaws.descricao: You wake every night at the Vitality level of Wounded (lethal), though you may be healed normally.
flaws.name: Ferimento Permanente

flaws.descricao: Because of your precarious emotional state, your Willpower fluctuates. At the start of each session, make a Simple Test. If you fail, you may only spend a single Willpower point during the session. Your total Willpower for testing still applies. You may test again at the start of the following night to see if you
flaws.name: Flashback

flaws.descricao: You have a fear of something that, when confronted with it, requires a Courage test Difficulty 3 (at minimum, depending on the Storyteller) or you enter Rotschreck.
flaws.name: Fobia

flaws.descricao: There is always something wrong with everything you create. All items crafted by you have at least one Negative Trait (Heavy, Noisy, Fragile), and even if you attempt to correct this flaw, another will appear to take its place. Your items may also have more than one flaw, depending on the haste of the maker. You also receive a permanent negative Trait of Repugnant or Callous due to your abrasive attitudes.
flaws.name: Endless #@%$#*$@ Frustration

flaws.descricao: You have a terrible doom. Whenever the Storyteller deems it appropriate, they may require you to spend 1 Willpower or you will suffer a 1 Trait penalty for the entire game due to a vision of imminent suffering and death.
flaws.name: Futuro Negro

flaws.descricao: The opposite of Downey, you tend to take everything and everyone at face value, which can be a very dangerous weak point for the Undead. For every two Traits dedicated to this flaw, up to six, you are left with one fewer Trait on all Social Challenges involving deceit and trickery. You had better hope that no one of suitably predatory nature knows about this little flaw, dove.
flaws.name: Gulpy

flaws.descricao: Telling lies or even distorting the truth is contrary to your nature, so much so that you will not do it unless it is necessary to save human lives. Naturally, this lack of practice tends to make you a poor deceiver when you attempt to distort the truth, and you are at 2 Traits down on any Social Challenge involving deception.
flaws.name: Honest to a Fault

flaws.descricao: RP. You have a double who runs amok out there.
flaws.name: Identidade Trocada

flaws.fonte: Laws of the Hunt: Players Guide
flaws.descricao: You are elderly (70 years old), your Physical Traits cap is reduced by 1. You may take this flaw more than once, for every additional 10 years of age.
flaws.name: Aging

flaws.descricao: You have no Reflexes. Lasombras cannot purchase this Flaw.
flaws.name: Imagem sem Reflexo

flaws.descricao: You can only cross running water when you are at least 15 meters above it. Pipes do not count as running water.
flaws.name: Incapaz de Atravessar Agua Corrente

flaws.descricao: You cannot help it — you naturally take people at face value, whether due to an optimistic view of people or simply a limited amount of contact with people whose motivations are not as noble as your own. You not only take them at their word, but also do reckless things, such as accepting a ride home from recent acquaintances or walking through bad areas at night, simply because you truly do not believe anything bad can happen. You have 2 Penalty Traits on all attempts to detect a lie or judge the character of someone you met during that session.
flaws.name: Trusting

flaws.descricao: You cannot speak clearly — perhaps your tongue rotted and fell out during the Embrace. You require the Linguistics Ability to communicate in sign language.
flaws.name: Incoerente

flaws.descricao: You lose ties when making tests to resist Frenzy.
flaws.name: Uncontrollable

flaws.descricao: Your bite transmits the Clan's madness to mortals.
flaws.name: Infectious

flaws.descricao: You suffer 1 Penalty Trait on Self-Control/Instinct tests due to itching. At the start of each game session — after the hunting roll — you must make 4 Simple Tests; for each failure you lose 1 Blood Point due to the parasites.

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: Fungi and Maggots. You suffer 1 Penalty Trait on Self-Control/Instinct tests due to itching. At the start of each game session — after the hunting roll — you must make 4 Simple Tests; for each failure you lose 1 Blood Point due to the parasites.

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: Fungi, Maggots, and other flying insects. You suffer 1 Penalty Trait on Self-Control/Instinct tests due to itching. At the start of each game session — after the hunting roll — you must make 4 Simple Tests; for each failure you lose 1 Blood Point due to the parasites. You also receive 1 Penalty Trait on Stealth and on Social Challenges that are not Intimidation.
You have one enemy (or a powerful organization) who opposes you.
flaws.name: Inimigo

flaws.descricao: For some reason, the Get of Fenris are hungry for your flesh. Perhaps you made your presence too obvious, or slew a werewolf in a duel. Perhaps the shapeshifters simply dislike you more than they dislike other vampires. Whatever the case, there is at least one pack hunting for you. You cannot travel without fear, and the shapeshifters' kin will always be a threat to your ghouls. If you maintain a haven, invest in heavy protection.
flaws.name: Inimizade com os Lupinos

flaws.descricao: Relating to people in an emotional context is a strange and uncomfortable experience for you, and your typical method of avoiding that discomfort — being very blunt about everything — does not usually help smooth things over either. More often than not you end up apologizing without knowing exactly what you did to offend someone, as you have difficulty understanding how other people are feeling. You have 1 Penalty Trait on all Social Challenges with someone under the influence of a strong emotion of any kind, and 2 Penalty Traits on all uses of the Empathy Ability (these penalties are cumulative).
flaws.name: Insensitive

flaws.descricao: You see nothing wrong with getting what you want through social pressure or physical force when it suits you. Beyond these charming characteristics, you do not tend to behave well when forced to follow a more forceful personality and tend to be a troublemaker when you are not in command.
