You have a 1 Trait penalty on all social challenges when you are not the authority figure, due to your irritation.
flaws.name: Bully

flaws.descricao: You begin blood bonded to another player.
flaws.name: Bound

flaws.descricao: There are many words for people like you, but regardless of how you want to look at things, even you admit that you rarely hold out long when it comes to resisting the sensual charms of the gender you favor. All attempts to seduce you have two additional Traits, and in general you make very poor decisions when it comes to people you find physically attractive, which should be roleplayed according to the Mind's Eye Theatre rules.
flaws.name: Lustful

flaws.fonte: Laws of the Night - Dark Ages: Faith and Fire
flaws.descricao: You were Embraced while suffering from leprosy or a similar disease. Your Appearance may not exceed 2 Traits, and rashes, blotches, scars, and festering sores weep from your flesh. You are treated with fear and revulsion. For 3 Traits, the disease is still contagious. This Flaw grants only 1 Trait to Nosferatu ONLY IF the disease is contagious.
flaws.name: Leproso

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
flaws.descricao: You gain the Tzimisce Clan Flaw.
flaws.name: Bound to the Earth

flaws.descricao: Your tongue is forked and whip-like, resembling that of a snake. You speak with a distinctive hissing sound, like thisss, Ssssetite. This tongue deals no aggravated damage and does not drain blood.
flaws.name: Forked Tongue

flaws.fonte: Laws of the Hunt: Players Guide
flaws.descricao: You speak unpleasant truths — or unpleasant things that are going to happen. You may deny this at the cost of 1 Willpower.
flaws.name: Bard's Tongue

flaws.descricao: You suffer a 1 Trait penalty on Self-Control/Instinct tests during the Crescent, Waning, or Half Moon. During the Full Moon the penalty is 2 Traits.
flaws.name: MoonMad

flaws.descricao: The Gift Scent of the Wyrm automatically registers a positive result on you.
flaws.name: Maculado pela Wyrm

flaws.descricao: You have an obvious tell when you attempt to lie — perhaps you stutter, change the tone of your voice, or simply lose your composure and begin to spiral worse and worse. Regardless, you must roleplay this difficulty whenever possible, and you have a 2 Trait penalty on all tests involving deception in a social situation.
flaws.name: Bad Liar

flaws.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
flaws.descricao: Either you practiced infernal diablerie and then attempted to sever the ties, or you have enraged infernal diabolists — whether Baali, Sabbat members, or mortal cultists. Whatever the case, you are the target of a demon's malevolent efforts. This demon constantly attempts to cause every manner of trouble for you, but will rarely be powerful enough to confront you directly.
flaws.name: Demon Plague

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
flaws.descricao: You radiate an aura of spiritual decay and death. Insects die when they fly too close to you, while small plants wither and die within a few centimeters of your presence. Even large trees deteriorate at the spot where you touch them. Large animals, including humans, suffer one level of lethal damage for every hour they spend near you. Such damage shows no external sign and manifests as an inexplicable weakness. You suffer a 2 Trait penalty on all Social tests that do not involve intimidation. Unlike the Freezing Touch Flaw, you actually leave a trail of withered grass and dried leaves as you walk.
flaws.name: Hand of Hades

flaws.descricao: When you are under pressure, your hands have a tendency to shake uncontrollably, making it difficult to perform actions that require any kind of manual dexterity (such as reloading a revolver or picking a lock). You may be as courageous as any other hunter, but you still suffer from this dangerous quirk and suffer a penalty of one Trait on all tests involving fine coordination. You must make a Physical Challenge against a difficulty of five Traits (retest with Firearms) to reload a revolver or shotgun during combat; a failure means your turn was wasted and you must attempt to reload again in another round.
flaws.name: Shaky Hands

flaws.descricao: Herbivores flee from you, and predators consider you a threat. You cannot have the Animal Empathy Ability.
flaws.name: Mark of Predator

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
flaws.descricao: The individual with this Flaw loses -2 Traits on all interactions involving artists or art critics, and on any attempt at Intimidation of any kind.
flaws.name: Poor Taste

flaws.descricao: Gangrel: You can only summon, speak with, and command one specific type of animal — crows, rats, and so forth — with Animalism. Your Storyteller is the best judge of which types of animals are appropriate for this Flaw, but the choice should be quite limiting. Other animals do not respond in any way to your use of Animalism.
flaws.name: Member of the Pack

flaws.descricao: RP. You are a Deserter.
flaws.name: Sect Member Under Observation

flaws.descricao: You possess a chaotic and wild mind, and have difficulty keeping your focus on one subject for very long. You suffer a penalty of 1 Trait on any successive tests in a prolonged confrontation (not including combat, but including actions such as craft) as a result of your inability to keep your mind focused.
flaws.name: Wyld Mind

flaws.descricao: Whether you are good at it or not, you tend to inject your own special blend of untruth into what you say, ranging from small lies to falsehoods that can potentially harm others (especially when it comes to fellow hunters). At this point you may even believe the lies you invent, since you tell them so frequently. Regardless, you must roleplay this constant level of fabrication as best you can; furthermore, to tell the complete truth about a situation, you must spend a Willpower Trait or win a Willpower Challenge against four Traits. This is also the case when you must tell a truth that openly exposes a previous lie.
flaws.name: Compulsive Liar

flaws.descricao: Appearance 0, you cannot initiate social tests other than Intimidation. Nosferatu and Samedis cannot have this Flaw.
flaws.name: Monstruoso

flaws.descricao: You have no fangs, needing to draw blood by other means (a knife, for example). Since you lack the ecstasy of the Kiss, a Physical test will generally be required to grab someone.
flaws.name: Mordida Entorpecida

flaws.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: Faith and Fire
flaws.descricao: Unlike other vampires, running your tongue over a bite wound will not close it. These wounds also have a 1 in 5 chance of becoming infected.
flaws.name: Mordida Imperfeita

flaws.descricao: Make a simple test after hunting; if you lose, the mortal contracts a serious disease.
flaws.name: Mordida Infecciosa

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the Low Clans
flaws.descricao: Like the vampires of legend, a wooden stake driven through your heart can destroy you immediately. This Flaw is worth two points if the stake must be carved from a specific type of wood, such as ash or rowan, to inflict Final Death. If any wooden stake can kill you, this Flaw is worth five points. Vampires with this Flaw are unaware of their vulnerability (obviously).
flaws.name: Morto por Estacamento

flaws.descricao: Mute. Must have Linguistics to communicate in sign language.
flaws.name: Mudo

flaws.descricao: The vampire who possesses this Flaw is barred from entering any private location, mortal residence, or communal dwelling to which they have not explicitly received an invitation from one of the residents. In places with firm traditions of hospitality, the vampire must be invited according to all the formal customs of the location. In less formal places, the invitation must be clear and explicit. The invitation need not come from the owner of the home, but the vampire cannot circumvent this Flaw by receiving an invitation from just anyone who does not have an intimate connection to the dwelling. A common Flaw for accepted members among the Ashirra.
flaws.name: Uninvited

flaws.descricao: Bringing up subjects that you know others would rather avoid is extremely uncomfortable for you, and you often find yourself giving in and accepting compromises you will later regret. It is not that you are weak — it is simply that you hate being seen as a source of unhappiness to those you care about, so much so that you will do almost anything to avoid it if possible. Whenever you are the bearer of bad news or must tell a friend or acquaintance something unpleasant, you are at a 2 Trait penalty on all Social Challenges for the rest of the scene, as a result of your hesitation and distress.
flaws.name: Nonconfrontational

flaws.descricao: You enjoy the company of corpses. RP.
flaws.name: Necrophile

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Road of The Beast
flaws.descricao:
During conversations, you cannot help but reframe everything in terms of the hunt. You do not speak of rivals or enemies — you speak of prey. You do not speak of nations and circles — you speak of territories and packs. This Flaw may seem peculiar at first, but it quickly becomes irritating. This Flaw must be roleplayed, and the Storyteller should apply penalties to your social tests (generally a 1 Trait penalty, but the penalty may be greater depending on circumstances) whenever they see fit.
Alternatively, you may speak little, but act as though you are always on the hunt. You shift position rapidly, crane your neck to listen and then leap suddenly onto a table, move slowly and furtively through a room, bare your teeth when angered, and so on.
flaws.name: Obcessed with the Hunt

flaws.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
flaws.descricao: You are hated by the faeries. They find you utterly repulsive because of some action from your past — or even for no reason at all. You cannot interact with them in any way, and whenever they have the opportunity they will attempt to hinder all of your endeavors.
flaws.name: Odiado por Fadas

flaws.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: Faith and Fire
flaws.descricao: You hate one thing — be it a type of people, a Clan, or an ideal — and will do everything in your power to harm it.
flaws.name: Hatred

flaws.descricao: Your eyes are a startling color, perhaps blazing crimson or the color of a full moon. Whatever they are, they are clearly not normal. This makes you easy to track by anyone who knows your... distinction. You must describe the unusual color of your eyes to everyone you meet.
flaws.name: Changeling’s Eyes

flaws.descricao: Your eyes glow like a full moon. You gain the Negative Social Trait Bestial and the Negative Mental Trait Obvious; however, you gain the Social Trait Intimidating.
flaws.name: Olhos Incandecentes

flaws.descricao: Your philosophy is clear: you will not use violence of any kind, nor will you carry a weapon or purchase one for another. If given the opportunity, you will do everything within your power to persuade others to adopt a path of non-violence as well, though you need not necessarily risk your life to do so. When confronted with particularly serious outrages, such as a loved one being harmed in front of you, you must make a Willpower test Difficulty 5 to avoid resorting to violence in response. If you commit an act of violence for any reason, you will not recover Willpower during the session unless you come to terms with your transgression in some way — typically through excellent roleplaying — or completely abandon your life philosophy (i.e., buy off this Flaw).
flaws.name: Pacifista

flaws.descricao: You had a long-term affair (minimum 50 years) with another Member. Although the relationship was an enjoyable diversion while it lasted, you eventually grew tired of your lover and ended things. Unfortunately, your former lover did not take this well and developed a strong resentment toward you. Or perhaps you were the one who was abandoned, cast aside like an unwanted doll by a bored child. You both know many of each other's secrets, and this has helped keep things at a standstill for now, but your ex may interfere in your affairs at a crucial moment. The cost of this Flaw depends on the relative power and standing of your former lover in Kindred society — one Trait for an ancilla, two for an elder of equal standing to yourself, and three for someone of superior standing.
flaws.name: Paramour Amargo

flaws.descricao: You have had a quirk since birth. You gain one of the following Negative Traits (which cannot be bought off): Callous, Forgetful, Impatient, Submissive, Gullible, Condescending, Naive, Ignorant, Violent, Tactless.
flaws.name: Quirk

flaws.descricao: When you receive wounds, you gain the Negative Trait Repugnant - it goes away when you heal or sleep.
flaws.name: Cadaverous Skin

flaws.descricao: Gain the Negative Physical Trait Crippled x3. You automatically lose tests that require the use of both legs (such as Dancing, for example).
flaws.name: Perna Atrofiada

flaws.descricao: When you have nightmares (at the Storyteller's discretion), you suffer a 1 Trait penalty on all tests.
flaws.name: Pesadelos

flaws.descricao: No matter how hard you try, you always seem to fall in with the wrong crowd. Your "friends" tend to be opportunists, petty criminals, and other unsavory types, and suffice to say your romantic history is probably long, tragic, and highly repetitive. You suffer a 2 Trait penalty on all Challenges related to Conscience, Empathy, or Intuition in social situations, due to your difficulty in judging people correctly, and at the Storyteller's discretion you may occasionally face difficulties with Backgrounds such as Allies or Contacts if they involve your questionable associates.
flaws.name: Poor Judge of Character

flaws.descricao: You are poor for an older vampire. Perhaps you simply never saved anything over the years, perhaps you lost your wealth in some catastrophe and never recovered, or perhaps you donated it to whatever cause you patronize. You cannot acquire any money or other material wealth from your influences.
flaws.name: Pobreza

flaws.descricao: You spend 1 additional Blood Point when waking. Anyone who drinks from your Blood must make a Simple test; if they lose, they contract your Disease.
flaws.name: Disease Carrier

flaws.descricao: You are a passionate creature, always on an emotional rollercoaster of life's joys, rages, and sorrows. You lose Ties in any attempt to influence you emotionally - unless you manage to Overbid against the Challenger. You may spend Willpower to maintain emotional control, but even so the Traits of the challenge are lost.
flaws.name: Low Sef Control

flaws.descricao: You lose all Ties in Social Challenges with mortals that do not involve Intimidation.
flaws.name: Obvious Predator

flaws.fonte: Laws of the Night: Sabbat Guide
flaws.descricao: You avoid anything that requires effort on your part. For any actions that require preparation, there is a good chance you will not have prepared adequately. You lose one Trait for any spontaneous actions (including combat, unless it is part of a planned offensive).
flaws.name: Lazy

flaws.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
flaws.descricao: You are unable to retract your fangs. You must take great care that mortals do not see them. With Vicissitude 3 it is possible to forcibly retract the fangs, but the process is painful and they will return the following night.
flaws.name: Presas Irretrateis

flaws.descricao: Your fangs do not retract; beyond the obvious breach of the Masquerade, you gain the Negative Social Trait Bestial.
flaws.name: Presas Permanentes

flaws.descricao: You suffer a 2 Trait penalty on Social tests with Mortals.
flaws.name: Eerie Presence

flaws.fonte: Leis da Noite - Dark Ages: Faith and Fire
flaws.descricao: You maintained your faith after the Embrace and suffer because your beliefs forbid you from drinking the blood necessary to survive. For 2 Points you voluntarily restrict your feeding to animals or blood that has been drained through a ritual (very common among Jews and Muslims). With 4 Points you refuse to feed unless you are starving (3 Blood Points), and even then you may fall victim to depression or self-loathing for several nights after the forbidden act. Most of these vampires follow a path of Heaven.
flaws.name: Religious Prohibition

flaws.descricao: You have a ward you care deeply about and would do anything for them.
flaws.name: Protegido

flaws.descricao: You continue to rot. Whenever you receive damage, make a Simple Test; on a failure the damage becomes aggravated due to accelerated putrefaction.
flaws.name: Putrescence

flaws.descricao: Gangrel: Whenever you are cornered or physically restrained (such as by a cage or handcuffs), you suffer from acute anxiety. The difficulties of any test made under such circumstances are increased by 2 Traits.
flaws.name: Rat in a Cage

flaws.descricao: Whenever a Cainite with this Flaw spends more than one Blood Point, he immediately gains the Negative Traits Bestial x2 in addition to any other Negative Traits he may already possess, and has 2 fewer Traits in all Social Traits (except Intimidation, which gains 1 Bonus Trait). This effect lasts five minutes/rounds minus the character's Humanity level, to a minimum of one minute/round, but during that time it must be represented by makeup or description if possible, and certainly roleplayed as powerfully as possible. Spending multiple Blood Traits is cumulative with the duration of this effect, although the Negative Traits and other penalties are not cumulative.
flaws.name: Beast's Reflexction

flaws.descricao: When confronted with Garlic, spend 1 Willpower to ignore it for the scene, or else retreat 3 steps.
flaws.name: Repulsa a Alho

flaws.descricao: When confronted with Crosses, spend 1 Willpower to ignore it for the scene. When struck by Crosses the damage becomes Aggravated and it is not possible to reduce this damage with Fortitude.
flaws.name: Repulsa a Cruzes

flaws.descricao: RP
flaws.name: Ressentimento do Senhor

flaws.descricao: All Blood Point costs are doubled. Cannot create a blood bond. To Embrace someone, the victim must win a Simple Test.
flaws.name: Sangue Fraco

flaws.descricao: Humans only. Each of your Blood Points is worth 2 to vampires.
flaws.name: Sangue Potente

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
flaws.descricao: You are no longer able to drink mortal blood to sustain yourself and must feed on the vitae of other vampires. The sight, smell, or taste of human blood does not cause you Frenzy, as you no longer see it as sustenance.
flaws.name: Thirst of Caine

flaws.descricao: The sight of innocence awakens your beast. You must make a Self-Control Test to avoid entering Frenzy.
flaws.name: Thirst for Innocence

flaws.fonte: Dirty Secrets of the Black Hand
flaws.descricao: You are no longer able to drink blood from mortals to sustain yourself and must feed on the vitae of other vampires.
flaws.name: Sede de Matusalem

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
flaws.descricao: You gain the Ventrue Clan Flaw.
flaws.name: Sede Seletiva

flaws.descricao: You have a Dark Secret; when it is revealed you gain 1 appropriate Negative Trait or lose 1 Status.
flaws.name: Segredo Sombrio

flaws.descricao: You must inflict at least 2 health levels of damage with your teeth before you can freely drink the blood of a creature (once you have caused sufficient damage, your victim becomes docile due to the ecstasy of the kiss); you also cannot deal damage with bites.
flaws.name: Sem  Presas

flaws.descricao: Good evening, Zoro! Maps, compasses, even GPS technology and a personal guide - none of it is effective, you still get lost. You have trouble finding your way in all but the most familiar environments, and have 2 fewer Traits on any test to navigate or attempt to find your way to a location. This does not include tracking a target, though it can make for an interesting trip home, especially if it took you through some bad parts of town...
flaws.name: No Sense of Direction

flaws.descricao: You are very old and have failed to adapt to the use of telephones or cell phones. Or you are very traditionalist and refuse to speak with others except face-to-face.
flaws.name: Sem Telefone

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
flaws.descricao: You display the semblance of death upon your face and pallor, revealing your true condition to all who see you. You cannot simulate a flush of color as other Cainites can, and your condition increases the difficulty of social challenges that are not intimidation-based by +1 Trait.
flaws.name: Visage of Death

flaws.descricao: Insects swarm around you. Stealth tests have a 1 Trait Penalty.
flaws.name: Senhor das Moscas

flaws.descricao: RP. People treat you as if you had 1 less Status.
flaws.name: Senhor Indigno

flaws.descricao: Sunlight inflicts double damage on you. Moonlight inflicts 1 lethal damage per turn.
flaws.name: Sensibilidade a Luz

flaws.descricao: You have a very active sense of humor, but it is not exactly that of a healthy person - in fact, you tend to find amusing what other people consider disturbing or utterly disgusting, and therefore have a dreadful tendency to make inappropriate jokes at the worst possible moments. Whenever you encounter a bloody scene or an uncomfortable moment (such as someone consoling a crying victim, someone recounting a rape, etc.), you suffer a 2 Trait Penalty on Social tests due to your habit of belittling the situation or the people involved in it. Needless to say, you should roleplay this behavior to the best of your ability, as long as you remember to keep all jokes in character.
flaws.name: Ghoulish Sense of Humor

flaws.descricao: A bull in the social china shop, you tend to attract many unfortunate outbursts or icy stares in group situations because you miss the small social cues that other people naturally pick up on regarding taboo topics or sensitive personal matters. This is different from the Tactless Negative Trait because it reflects a broader range of inappropriate behaviors beyond merely verbal ones, from overstaying your welcome at parties to steamrolling over a person who is obviously emotionally compromised.
flaws.name: Socially Oblivious

flaws.descricao: Waking during the day requires a static Mental Challenge Difficulty 10, even if in danger.
flaws.name: Sono Pesado

flaws.descricao: You suffer a 2 Trait penalty on tests against any form of Magic. Rituals have double effect against you. Forbidden for those with Blood Magic.
flaws.name: Sucetivel a Magia

flaws.descricao: Deaf. Generally immune to Domination. You suffer a 3 Trait Penalty on Perception and Alertness tests - when applicable. Must have Linguistics to communicate in sign language.
flaws.name: Surdez

flaws.descricao: You hate modern technology, especially computers, and are absolutely certain that it hates you back. While you are at home with tried-and-true things like cars and telephones, understanding cell phones, pagers, laptops, or other modern devices is well beyond you. You must make a Mental Challenge against five Traits to accomplish even simple tasks on a computer, ATM, or other technological device with which you are not comfortable (which is most of them), and the Storyteller will likely restrict some of the Abilities you may use. Consider this at character creation to reflect this deficiency as well.
flaws.name: Tecnofobo

flaws.descricao: All of your beliefs have your full and unwavering support, and anyone who attempts to challenge them will be the target of as much grief as you can muster. Whenever someone questions one of your beliefs, you are two Traits down on all Social Challenges involving that character for the rest of the scene, as you naturally close yourself off to them (not to mention the embarrassment if they are actually right).
flaws.name: Stubborn

flaws.descricao: Roleplay this inability to properly recall such details. Should it become essential to remember such information, you must make a Mental Challenge against five Traits to recall what you are looking for; failure means you simply cannot manage it for the time being. (After all, you meet so many people in a day.)
flaws.name: Terrible With Names

flaws.descricao: You suffer a 2 Trait Penalty on Social interactions when with 3 or more people. This increases to a 3 Trait Penalty for groups of 10 or more people.
flaws.name: Timidez

flaws.descricao: You are very cold to the touch, and plants wither and die in your presence.
flaws.name: Toque do Congaleamento

flaws.descricao: You only have one arm. You have no penalties for "Off-Hand", but receive a 2 Trait penalty on tests that involve the use of both hands.
flaws.name: One Arm

flaws.descricao: You cannot help it - whenever there is a possible wager on the table, you simply must take it. This is bad news because although you likely have vast experience with gambling, you are also addicted to it, meaning you tend to lose far more than you win because you cannot walk away from the table when you are ahead. Beyond the obvious impact this can have on your Resources, you must also make a Willpower test against four Traits to pass up a chance to gamble. Once you have started, you must spend a Willpower Trait or make another test to stop gambling for any reason short of a direct threat, regardless of whether you are winning ("I am ahead now, so why stop?") or losing ("I have to at least break even!").
flaws.name: Gambling Addict

flaws.descricao: Humans only.
flaws.name: Addicted to Vampiric Blood

flaws.descricao: You can only feed on blood mixed with the substance to which you are addicted - it gives you an appropriate Negative Trait (Lethargic for alcohol, Impatient for cocaine, etc.)
flaws.name: Addiction

flaws.descricao: Some attitudes are hard to die, especially in an era like this, where perspectives are stratified and reinforced by hundreds of years of common knowledge. It is impossible not to see class and ethnic distinctions; these people are, frankly, inherently different from you. The difficulty of all Challenges related to Empathy, Leadership, Subterfuge, and Investigation increases by two if they involve people from a different social or economic group than your own, simply because you are more likely to see your own prejudices in action rather than the evidence before your eyes. Your behavior, if properly roleplayed, may well make many social activities more difficult among these groups as well, since your antipathy and disdain for them are very hard to hide.
flaws.name: Dangerous Bias

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Guide to the High Clans
flaws.descricao: Your eyes never close — not ever. Perhaps you stared too deeply into the abyss, or removed your eyelids to keep yourself more alert. This detail likely makes more attentive observers uncomfortable (+1 Trait Penalty on Social Tests in friendly social interactions with any character).
flaws.name: Unblinking Vigil

flaws.descricao: Whenever an opportunity for revenge arises, you must take it unless you spend 1 Willpower.
flaws.name: Vengeance

flaws.descricao: Everything around you appears dead and decaying (as if you were looking at the shadowlands). You gain the Negative Social Trait Callous and the Negative Mental Trait Oblivious. On the other hand, you have 2 Bonus Traits for Social Tests based on Appearance (such as Gorgeous or Seductive).
flaws.name: Death Sight

flaws.descricao: You have great difficulty moving in low-light conditions. You suffer a 2 Trait Penalty on all tests made in low light (such as those attempted by mere starlight or a single flashlight beam) and suffer an additional 1 Trait Penalty from a Characteristic in all combat conditions while fighting in conditions of little or no light.
flaws.name: Poor Night Vision

flaws.descricao: You are incapable of performing the Embrace on anyone (blood bonds and ghouls function normally). ICBN: Cannot establish blood bonds or ghouls.
flaws.name: Infertile Vitae

flaws.descricao: You cannot make tests to resist Domination (but remain immune to those of weaker Generation). You suffer a 2 Trait Penalty on Social and Mental tests. You cannot have Willpower higher than 3, regardless of your generation.
flaws.name: Vontade Fraca

flaws.fonte: Dark Ages: Libellus Sanguinis 2 - Keepers of the Word
flaws.descricao: You are rude, crude, and socially unacceptable. You seem constitutionally incapable of saying and doing the right things despite all attempts to teach you. Your sire is criticized and ridiculed for choosing you, and you are frequently left off invitation lists. You may eventually work off this Flaw, but the Storyteller should make the task extremely difficult. At the Storyteller's discretion, you suffer a 2 Trait Penalty on any social Challenges relating to etiquette and social graces.
flaws.name: Vulgar

flaws.descricao: Silver causes you Aggravated Damage. Additionally, you lose one Trait when in contact with this metal.
flaws.name: Vulnerabilidade a Prata

flaws.descricao: Born under an ill omen, you attract misfortune and complications wherever you go. Others consider you unlucky and often attribute failures and bad luck to your mere presence. Once per session, the Storyteller may declare one of your actions as 'bad luck,' giving your opponent an automatic success on a specific non-lethal challenge. You may use both this Flaw and the Auspicious Birth Merit to represent a character whose birth presents mixed blessings to those around them, as luck is in the eye of the beholder.
flaws.name: Insidios Birth

flaws.fonte: V20 - The Black Hand, A Guide to the Tal Mahe Ra
flaws.descricao: If you drain all the blood from a mortal vessel within minutes of the heart stopping, the corpse rises as a zombie (using the zombie statistics from Bone Path). These zombies have free will, are hostile toward you, and cannot be directed without some means of sorcery or necromancy to command them.
flaws.name: Beijo da Morte

flaws.fonte: V20 - The Black Hand, A Guide to the Tal Mahe Ra
flaws.descricao: In your presence, lights go out, small flames are extinguished, and shadows cling to you or move languidly with a surreal unlife, making it impossible to pass as anything other than inhuman. The specific shadow you cast is a malicious entity with a will of its own. It attacks friends and foes alike, destroying the scenery and snarling at passersby. These effects can be suppressed for a scene by spending one Willpower point.
flaws.name: Senhor da Noite

flaws.descricao: You are completely subject to the Shadowlands and the ghosts therein. Ghostly architecture blocks you and ghostly attacks can harm you. You cannot actually see the Beyond without the use of another power, but you can be hindered by it. When and if this occurs is up to the Storyteller, but it can be a major obstacle if you are trying, say, to attend a meeting and a ghostly wall bars the entrance to the room, or if you need to flee an enemy while ghosts also assail you. Logically, the Storyteller should take an opportunity once per game to manifest some inconvenience, causing one of your actions to fail automatically. This failure could be as simple as 'You cannot flee because you run into a wall' or perhaps, 'Your attempt to Dominate the mortal fails because a ghost suddenly screams and begins firing a weapon at you'. For a Challenge, you fail automatically, despite retests.
flaws.name: Andarilho das Sombras

flaws.descricao: Flaw available only to those of 12th Generation or higher. Your Generation never decreases; if you commit Diablerie you will have the benefits for one scene, after which you will vomit blood.
flaws.name: Fixed Generation

flaws.descricao: You have no experience in the outdoors (believing the outside world is full of catastrophes, etc). Any outdoor action (survival, hunting, etc) has a 2 Trait penalty.
flaws.name: Rural Fear

flaws.descricao: You are followed everywhere by ill omens. Crows fly overhead, black dogs trail you, an owl hoots before you speak, etc.
flaws.name: Plagued

flaws.descricao: You are dead inside, without any empathy or concern for mortals; you rationalize all social actions. You may never bid more Social Traits than your Mental Traits.
flaws.name: Unfelling
